AREAS.md.C-AR-ABSENCE-RULE: **A claim of absence is only as wide as the search behind it**, and this search was two layers deep.
AREAS.md.C-AR-AGG: The national argument is made in aggregates: one land-borne load, and one share of it for agriculture - 69.6% in the figure DANVA cites from Miljøstyrelsen and Aarhus University. Aggregation is where the information goes: a figure true of Denmark need not hold for any one water body inside it.
AREAS.md.C-AR-ASSIGN: Assignment is by nearest point on the marine boundary, one rule for every layer, with the largest distance kept for each layer in each area and anything beyond 20 km dropped.
AREAS.md.C-AR-CUMHOC: A national time series has one unit of replication. The water bodies with two or more bathing stations number 65, so an effect size can be estimated across them.
AREAS.md.C-AR-CUMHOC-DESIGN: This sets bathing-water quality against sewage pressure — outfall, treatment-plant and basin density per km² — because both sides of that pair exist per area. It is **cum hoc**: a correlation across places at one time, with no control for coast type, flushing, or population.
AREAS.md.C-AR-ENCLOSURE: "Roskilde Fjord" is not an arbitrary line on a map, and it is worth saying so plainly before objecting to anything. It names a real hydrographic object: an inlet bounded by land that opens to the sea through Isefjorden. That is a **claim about enclosure**, it is physical, and it is true.
AREAS.md.C-AR-GAP-CLASSES: The distinction inside that table matters as much as the table. `closed` is a gap in the world's availability; `open_unassembled` is a gap in our effort and is nobody's fault but ours; `absent` is the only one where a search was run to the end, and even that is bounded by the search.
AREAS.md.C-AR-GAPS: **And the corpus is named together with what is missing from it.** A coverage figure has a numerator nobody can measure — the evidence that exists — so counting what we assembled gives a *lower bound on evidence* and therefore an *upper bound on absence*. That is only interpretable beside the terms we know belong in the numerator and cannot add. They are kept in `data/manual/coverage_gaps.json`, a hand-kept record, in three kinds:
AREAS.md.C-AR-HOMOGENEITY: The assessment then uses the same word to mean something else entirely: that a measurement taken anywhere in it stands for the whole of it. That is a **claim about homogeneity**, and it is statistical. One sense is about where the water is bounded; the other is about whether the water inside those bounds is alike. Nothing carries you from the first to the second, and the name does the carrying unnoticed because the same three words serve both.
AREAS.md.C-AR-ILTSVIND: In Denmark, oxygen below 4 mg/L is called iltsvind.
AREAS.md.C-AR-LIFT-RULE: A partition's value is not how well it predicts, but **how much better it predicts than its own shape alone would**.
AREAS.md.C-AR-MODEL-MATCH: **The model flag follows DHI's list.** A water body counts as modelled when DHI's 2015 method report lists it among the water bodies with a station-level statistical model, matched to this layer by DHI's water-body number, with every name read against the layer's own (`data/manual/statistical_models.json`). One of DHI's models covers five Limfjord bredninger together, so all five are counted; one water body it lists, Randers Fjord's Grund Fjord, is not in the marine layer used here.
AREAS.md.C-AR-NAMED-CORPUS: So absence is reported here as a count over a named corpus, and the corpus is named every time.
AREAS.md.C-AR-NEITHER: Counted with that flag, 46 water bodies covering 24,359 km² (56% of Danish sea) carry neither the flag nor a repeated observation **in the two layers counted here** — bathing water, and the hazardous-substance layer, which holds no marine point.
AREAS.md.C-AR-NOT: It is not a causal model per area. It is the ledger you need before you can build one: which areas have enough observation to support a claim, which have none, and over which years each stream exists — so that an analysis published in 2025 cannot quietly rest on a relation fitted to 1990–2012 without a reader seeing the gap.
AREAS.md.C-AR-NOT-PERCENT: **Those are counts, and they are deliberately not percentages.** Saying *8% of the sea has no long observation* would be the missing-denominator error this project exists to point at. The denominator is known — the sea is 43,579 km². The numerator is not, because it is the extent of an absence, and an absence can only be measured against a search that was exhaustive. Ours was ODA plus two layers; ICES and EMODnet sit outside it, and so does whatever university, municipal or unpublished series exist.
AREAS.md.C-AR-NULLS: The three nulls answer three different questions. **Shuffled** permutes station labels while keeping basket sizes, so it destroys geography and keeps the size structure. **Latitude stripes** are equal-count horizontal bands, as many as there are real baskets, so they keep compactness and equal sizes but ignore hydrography. **Size- and shape-matched** baskets have the same size distribution as the real ones and are grown from random seeds by nearest neighbour, three times over, so they are compact blobs of the right sizes following no hydrography at all — the only control that varies one thing at a time.
AREAS.md.C-AR-PART-STAT: A partition is not right or wrong in general; it is predictive *for a variable*. So the question is what the water bodies encode. The statistic, computed within month by `scripts/partition_score.py`, is a **ratio of mean squares**: the between-basket mean square over the sum of the between- and within-basket mean squares. One means stations in the same basket agree completely. With labels that carry no information both mean squares estimate the same variance and the ratio sits near one half, not zero — so no value in the table below can be read on its own, only its difference from a null.
AREAS.md.C-AR-PHYSICS: **And where exchange is restricted, the physics runs against the transfer, not with it.** Restricted exchange is what *preserves* a gradient. A basin with freshwater entering at its head and little exchange at its mouth holds salinity, residence-time and oxygen gradients along its length because it does not flush; open water erases such differences by mixing. So the better the enclosure, the weaker the homogeneity assumption becomes: the two senses **pull in opposite directions**, and the enclosures that most deserve their names are the ones least entitled to be treated as single units.
AREAS.md.C-AR-POSITION: The practical rule that follows, and the reason the station-level series exist: **the unit of observation is a position.** Everything else — this page included — is an aggregate computed inside somebody's polygon, and should be read as a statement about that polygon as much as about the sea.
AREAS.md.C-AR-PULS: **PULS is the sharpest case.** It holds the per-event overflow volumes that B1 calls the single most valuable missing series — volumes that are themselves largely modelled, by this project's source register — and an access attempt with a private MitID was refused because no CVR or VAT number attached to it was valid, so this is not a login anyone has neglected to perform. Access appears to require a registered business or authority, in which case a private citizen cannot obtain it.
AREAS.md.C-AR-READING: One reading fits these numbers, and it is not tested here: if salinity is spatially smooth, any compact grouping predicts it well (0.844 from random blobs) and the real boundaries have little left to add; if oxygen is spatially rough, blobs do poorly and boundaries that follow enclosure carry real information.
AREAS.md.C-AR-RECORD: The full record for each area — every pressure, every stream with its years, and the written-out list of what cannot be modelled there — is in `data/derived/areas.json`, which `scripts/areas.py` writes locally and the repository does not ship, and drawn with its timeline on [the map](areas.html).
AREAS.md.C-AR-REGISTER: ODA's station register holds **6,258 positioned marine stations**.
AREAS.md.C-AR-REQUIREMENT: A requirement does not wait for either: in the method behind the second water plans, every one of its 119 water bodies was given an indsatsbehov, whether it had a statistical model or not.
AREAS.md.C-AR-REVERSAL: Against the matched blobs the ordering **reverses**: surface oxygen saturation gains most (+0.402), surface salinity little (+0.124), and fluorescence's lift is below zero (-0.050) — but the three blob runs themselves spread by 0.109 for fluorescence, so for it the official partition does no better than random compact blobs, and whether it does worse is not shown.
AREAS.md.C-AR-ROSK-HALVES: **And the two halves fail on different variables.** The inner fjord's stations disagree for oxygen (0.65) and agree for salinity (0.29); the outer fjord's are the reverse — close for oxygen (0.25), apart for salinity (0.87). Within this one fjord, a boundary drawn to serve one variable does not serve the other. That is one case, not a proof about every partition; it is the case `X22` would test systematically.
AREAS.md.C-AR-ROSK-METHOD: The station-level series make this checkable rather than arguable. Both halves of Roskilde Fjord carry several stations, so for any month where 3 or more measured, the disagreement *between* stations can be set against the variation *across* months. *Spread between stations* is the population standard deviation across the stations in a month, averaged over the months, beside the median range; *spread across months* is the standard deviation of the monthly means.
AREAS.md.C-AR-ROSK-OXY: **The inner fjord's own stations disagree about bottom oxygen by a median of 3.35 mg/l within a single month.** A spread that size is most of the distance from zero to that threshold, so in a month when the fjord's bottom water is near it, one station can read below and another above — and whether that body "has iltsvind" can then depend on which of its own stations is read. The ratio puts it another way: the spread between stations is **65% of the spread of the monthly means across months**.
AREAS.md.C-AR-ROSK-SOURCE: Computed by `scripts/station_places.py` from `docs/data/areas/stations_series.*`, which carry no partition at all — the water-body assignment used here is loaded separately from `station_waterbody_overlay.json`, on purpose, so that using it is a deliberate act.
AREAS.md.C-AR-SAME-WIDTH: **Same width — an exact statement is fine, including of an absence.** *None of the 123 water bodies has a marine point in the national hazardous-substance layer: its 256 points are 152 lake and 104 river.* The category is that layer and the count is of all of it, so its complement is exact.
AREAS.md.C-AR-SAMPLED: One further limit bounding every row: stations are not placed at random and are far denser in some baskets than others, so this scores the partition *as sampled*. It cannot distinguish a well-drawn basket from one whose stations happen to sit close together.
AREAS.md.C-AR-SCOPE: This page refuses the aggregate. One record per marine water body: what presses on it, what is observed in it, **over which years each of those streams exists**, and what cannot be modelled there.
AREAS.md.C-AR-SERIES-COVERAGE: The part of it this page can place in water bodies is the station series behind the partition tests below — 1,415 stations with a monthly record, 1,313 of them inside a water body by point in polygon — and **119 of the 123 water bodies contain at least one of those.** Counted over that series: 4 water bodies contain no station with data in 2 or more distinct years, 10 water bodies contain no station with data in 5 or more distinct years, 12 water bodies contain no station with data in 10 or more distinct years.
AREAS.md.C-AR-SPLIT-UNSTATED: The documents this project holds give the general basis for water bodies' boundaries — the water framework directive asks member states to set them, and the plans sort coastal waters into types with a catchment each — but none of them says why this fjord is two units rather than one or three, or what measurement would settle it.
AREAS.md.C-AR-TABLE-KEY: `model` — a DHI statistical model, as described above (DCE fitted its statistical models on 1990–2012). `bath` — bathing stations, and the years they span. `r` — the mean correlation between the yearly classes of a water body's informative bathing stations, where there are three or more. `RBU` — rain-conditioned outfalls. `PE` — approved treatment-plant load. `gaps` — the number of written-out reasons this area cannot be modelled.
AREAS.md.C-AR-THREE-RANKINGS: **The result depends almost entirely on what it is compared against, and three reasonable comparisons give three different rankings.**
AREAS.md.C-AR-TWO-UNITS: The partition half-concedes this without following it through. Roskilde Fjord appears here as two water bodies, `DKCOAST1` (ydre, 71 km²) and `DKCOAST2` (indre, 52 km²) — an admission that one enclosure is at least two units.
AREAS.md.C-AR-WIDER: **Category wider than corpus — only a count is honest.** *56% of the sea has no marine observation* would name a category — marine observation — far wider than the two layers actually searched, and report the leftover after subtracting what we happened to find as though it were measured, which is the operation [RESIDUAL.md](RESIDUAL.md) is about.
AREAS.md.C-AR-WINNERS: Against the shuffle, salinity gains most, by a distance; against the stripes, surface oxygen saturation does.
AREAS.md.C-AR-WITHIN-MONTH: Within month is essential. Every station in Denmark shares a season, so pooling across months puts the seasonal signal into the between-basket term and makes every partition look excellent, including an absurd one.
AREAS.md.C-AR-X22: A boundary drawn inside a fjord is a hypothesis about where the water changes, and it can be tested: `X22` in [EXPERIMENTS.md](EXPERIMENTS.md) sets out how, using pairs of measurements at matched separation either side of a line.

CATEGORY.md.C-AR-ATTRIBUTION: **An attribution.** What members are taken to share. This is a *statistical* claim, and nothing in the membership rule establishes it.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-CAT-COMPANION: This is the companion to [RESIDUAL.md](RESIDUAL.md), and the same shape of mistake one column to the left. That page is about a *number* nobody measured being treated as one. This is about a *category* nobody measured being treated as one.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-CITIZENSHIP: **Citizenship.** A legal status, acquired by the routes a country's law sets out. It can be used as a proxy for population, culture, ancestry, or behaviour — none of which the membership rule tracks. The rule is *legal*; the attribution is *biological or cultural*.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-CONDITION: **Condition on what everything shares.** Every marine station in Denmark experiences the same season. Pool across months and the seasonal signal lands in the between-basket term and *every* partition scores well — including a deliberately absurd one. The same applies wherever a common driver exists: compare within year, within cohort, within whatever the members hold in common regardless of basket.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-DEFECT: The measurement above has a defect that has to be stated before the worked example, because it applies to every number on this page.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-DEMAND: If the answer to the third is unknown, the category is being used as data when it is a model, and any figure computed inside it is a statement about the basket at least as much as about the world.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-DIFFERENCE: A circular statistic compared against a *shape-matched null* stops being circular, because the null partitions were not chosen to be real. Each number separately depends on the assumption; the **difference** between them measures what the chosen partition adds. That is the argument for the exercise below, and it is why a single reported value — a bare $F_{\mathrm{ST}}$, a bare intraclass correlation, a bare $R^2$ between groups — cannot by itself say whether the groups are anything.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-ESTIMATORS: Nor is it one statistic. After Wright's, papers gave differing definitions and estimators, and published estimates for the same pairs of populations have moved more than twofold with the estimation method, the way estimates are combined across loci and the choice of loci. It is an aggregation function over a chosen metric, presented as an observable.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-FST-CIRCLE: **The intraclass correlation takes the partition as an input.** So does $F_{\mathrm{ST}}$, a statistic of the same family in population-genetics clothing: $F_{\mathrm{ST}} = (H_T - H_S)/H_T$, and $H_S$ — the variation *within subpopulations* — cannot be computed until the subpopulations have been declared. Citing an $F_{\mathrm{ST}}$ value as evidence that populations are distinct therefore assumes what it sets out to show, unless it is set against what partitions not chosen to be real would give.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-ICC-FAMILY: There is a standard family of statistics for this: the **intraclass correlation** and its relatives. Pick two members of the population at random. If they are in the same basket, how much more alike are they than two picked without regard to basket? For the intraclass correlation, one means membership tells you everything and zero means it tells you nothing. The scores this project computes are a relative — a ratio of mean squares, on which no information reads near one half rather than zero — which is one more reason to read only their difference from a null.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-ICD: **Diagnosis codes.** For more than a century the basis for comparable statistics on causes of death and disease, and now also used for resource allocation and reimbursement — a membership rule built for counting, used to stand for a condition.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-LIFT-RULE: **A partition's value is not how well it predicts, but how much better it predicts than its own shape alone would.**
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-MEMBERSHIP: **A membership rule.** Who is in. This is usually sound, often precise, and frequently a genuine fact about the world. Roskilde Fjord really is an enclosure. Danish citizenship really is a determinate legal status. A postcode really is a postcode.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-NO-ERRORBAR: **Not one of them has an error bar, and not one of them was measured.** Each is the output of a model — a polygon someone drew, a legal test someone applied, a classification someone wrote down — presented in the same table, in the same typeface, as the quantities that came off an instrument. The instrument reading is an observation with a known error. The category is a claim with an unstated one.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-NULL-CONDITIONED: A null answers: **given these measurements, does this grouping beat chance?** The answer is still conditioned on which measurements were taken, so it cannot separate a property of the entities from an artifact of what someone chose to record.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-NULL-LIMIT: The null comparison above is not the strongest test available. It is the strongest test available *when the feature space is small*.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-OWN-EXAMPLE: This page's own worked example sits below that threshold — 9 variables, so 4 per half, and far from independent: oxygen and its saturation, the same quantity at two depths — which is why the marine result is suggestive only. The method wants a case with dozens of characters per entity, which is what `../organism` exists to try.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-POSTCODE: **Deprivation by postcode.** An area statistic attributed to the individuals in it — which is the ecological fallacy, and the same error [AREAS.md](AREAS.md) reports for Denmark.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-QUESTION: The name serves both functions, so the switch between them goes unnoticed. Asking "is this a real category?" answers the first question and is almost always yes. The question that has content is different:
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-RACE: **Race.** A dispute in the literature turns on exactly this statistic. By Edwards's account it is often stated, after Lewontin in 1972, that about 85% of human genetic variation lies within populations and only 15% between them. Edwards (2003) replied that the information distinguishing populations lies in the correlations between loci, so classification can be accurate anyway — the shape of the compact-null finding above, where compact groupings of a smooth field score well wherever they are cut. Rosenberg et al. (2002) found clusters without using the individuals' origins; Serre & Pääbo (2004), sampling individuals homogeneously across the globe, found gradients rather than discrete clusters. Sampling design, again.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-READING: One reading fits these numbers, and it is not tested here: if salinity is spatially smooth, *any* compact grouping predicts it well and real boundaries have little left to add; if oxygen is rough, shape alone fails and boundaries that follow enclosure carry real information.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-RESCUE: **This is why the null is not a refinement. It is the thing that rescues the measurement.**
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-REVERSAL: Only the third varies one thing at a time, and against it the ordering from the first **reverses** — oxygen saturation gains most, salinity little — and fluorescence's lift is below zero but inside the spread of the three blob runs, so for fluorescence the official partition does no better than random compact blobs.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-SAMPLING: The partition can come from the **sampling design** itself. Collect fifty Danes and fifty Dutch and "Danish" and "Dutch" are your groups by construction; the statistic then reports on a boundary the fieldwork drew.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-SECTOR: **Industrial sector** (SIC, NACE). A code attached to each firm from a classification; productivity and emissions can then be compared "within sector".
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-SELF-APPLY: this project sorts 166 mechanisms into 17 groups, which is a partition it has not scored either.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-SHAPE-NULL: **Compare against a null that matches the basket's shape.** This is the part that gets skipped, and skipping it is how a defensible number comes out backwards.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-SMALL-SPACE: A feature space of three or four measurements cannot be split into disjoint halves: there is nothing to hold out, and a null is the only test available.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-SPECIES: **Species.** Species concepts agree that a species is a separately evolving lineage but disagree about which further property makes one — reproductive isolation, diagnosability, monophyly — so the same organisms can be sorted differently. Which concept to use is argued over; which one predicts a given trait is a question with an answer.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-SPLIT-TEST: A grouping that appears only when one particular measurement is included is an artifact of that measurement. A grouping that appears whichever features are drawn is a property of the entities. Convergence as the subsets widen is the signal; flat agreement near chance means there is nothing to converge on. The official partition is then scored on the same axis — its agreement with each derivation — so it is one candidate among them rather than the standard they are marked against.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-TELL: Open the Danish marine monitoring archive this project holds. Its measured columns come with what a measurement comes with: a sonde serial number, a sampling instrument, an analysis method, a laboratory, a quality level, and a mark for a value below what the method could detect.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-THRESHOLD: **So the rule is a threshold, not a preference.** Below 12 independent features — a judgment, stated as one — use a shape-matched null and accept that it cannot distinguish the entities from the instrument. Above that, split the feature space, because you can.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-TWO-THINGS: Every basket carries two things that are easy to conflate, and the conflation is the whole problem:
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-WHERE-MANY: Where many measurements accumulate on the same entities, the stronger test is available and the weaker one is a habit.
CATEGORY.md.C-AR-WINNERS: The winners are read from the scores, and the first two disagree, not marginally: surface oxygen saturation gains **+0.065** over the shuffle and **+0.408** over the stripes, while against the shuffle salinity gains most.

CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-AGRILOAD: So the agricultural part of that term is roughly **41–49 kt N/yr** on this project's bounds. That is a real quantity and it is not small. The question is what it is a share *of*.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-AR-1: - **the trigger and the fuel are different quantities.** External input can be small and still start something that runs on internal stock;
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-AR-2: - **the same input produces different outcomes** depending on how far round the loop the system already is — the state-dependence of section 7, arriving by a second route;
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-AR-3: - **there are thresholds.** Below one, the loop damps; above it, the loop runs. Attribution either side of that line means different things;
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-AR-4: - **history matters.** What is in the sediment was delivered in earlier years, and it is released on the sediment's schedule, not this year's.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-ASYMMETRY: **And it shows an asymmetry in what gets counted.** Every term that would shift blame away from a countable source — deposition, regeneration, groundwater, legacy, temperature, state — is a term with no line in the apportionment quoted. That may be coincidence of what is easy to measure. It is worth noticing that the easy measurements and the politically actionable ones are the same set.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-BC: Routes B and C are not exotic. B is what a combined sewer overflow carries. C is what a hypoxic event or a toxicant pulse does. Neither is a line in the nitrogen apportionment, which counts nitrogen mass.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-CANNOT: Both readings sit in the same record. **That the record so far cannot distinguish them is an argument that the accounting measures the wrong thing.**
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-CEILING: On this project's own bounds, agriculture accounts for **no more than 30%** of enumerated reactive nitrogen reaching Danish marine waters — and at the wide end of the bounds as little as 13%. Filling an empty row lowers that ceiling, unless the register's own notes put the row inside another or make it a timing term, as [LANDBRUG.md](LANDBRUG.md) sets out row by row. The bounds carry no source for each row, so the ceiling is only as good as they are.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-CEILINGS: *Both columns are ceilings.* Not all COD is degradable on a relevant timescale, and not all nitrogen is assimilated. The two overstatements run in the same direction, so the **ratio** is the robust part; the absolute milligrams are not.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-CONSEQUENCE: **The consequence for the 69.6%.** For fedtemøg, which is grown, nitrogen is on the path and the question is how much of the nitrogen growing it is agriculture's. For iltsvind, removing nitrogen would close route A and leave routes B and C running.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-CSO: A combined sewer overflow carries **68 mg of organic carbon per litre directly**, and enough nitrogen to grow **68 mg C/l** — a ratio of **0.99**. The two routes are the same size. The nitrogen apportionment counts only the second, and in this project's register the overflow's nitrogen is 0.6–0.7% of the land-based term.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-DANVA: Agriculture alone accounts for 69.6% of nitrogen discharged — DANVA, citing data from Miljøstyrelsen and Aarhus University
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-DCE-WEATHER: DCE's own notes explain how an iltsvind season develops by the weather of the year: wind that mixes the water column slows it, and high water temperature promotes it, because oxygen consumption rises with temperature and oxygen's solubility falls.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-DEPOSITION: Two terms set the scale of what the share leaves out. **Atmospheric deposition to Danish marine waters is 45–65 kt N/yr** in this project's register — comparable to the entire land-based term, falling on the water directly, and not a line in the apportionment quoted.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-DIFFERENT: The published 69.6% and this ceiling are not competing estimates of the same thing. They answer different questions, and only the second is the question an outcome at sea raises.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-DN: "År efter år har vi set forfærdeligt iltsvind og fedtemøg. Skal havet have en chance, må landbrugets kvælstofforurening ned." — Maria Reumert Gjerding, president of Danmarks Naturfredningsforening, on the nitrogen agreement
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-E5: The register's E5 proposes a different start: a bay receiving a large, pulsed delivery of sewage solids and fat can enter the loop further along — the organic material and the oxygen demand arrive together, already made, and the die-off that releases the internal store can be the *first* step. Whether that happens in Køge Bugt is not tested here.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-E5-SHAPE: It is a different causal shape from the one the accounting models, it could produce the same shore, and any method that counts only nitrogen would attribute it to nitrogen.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-ESTABLISH: **It does establish that the number is not what it is read as.** "69.6% of nitrogen" is a residual of models over one term of an open account. Read as a share of fedtemøg, it is multiplied by coefficients nobody here has computed. The first is a defensible piece of bookkeeping. The second is not a measurement of anything.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-EVERYLINK: Every one of those links is a real causal connection, and none of them has a number here. A product of unknown fractions is an unknown fraction — **not a small one**. Agriculture may still be the largest single contributor at every link; this project has not computed it either way, and no source it holds does.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-FAT: Part of what an overflow carries is fat, which contains **0%** nitrogen and takes **~2.9 g O₂ per g** to oxidise, against ~1.1 for carbohydrate: a nitrogen account cannot see it at all.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-FEDT-DEF: *Fedtemøg* is a popular name for mass occurrences of loose-lying filamentous brown algae that can lie rotting at the water's edge and on the beach ([Danish Wikipedia](https://da.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedtem%C3%B8g)).
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-FEEDBACK: That is the ordinary behaviour of a system with positive feedback.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-FLOOR: The enumerated pathways that carry any number sum to **167 – 327 kt N/yr**, with **10 of 20 rows empty**. An empty row can only add, so the sum is a floor on the denominator, and a share computed against it is a **ceiling, not an estimate**:
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-FOOTER: The pinned documents behind each statement are listed under its claim in [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md). The pathway enumeration is in `data/manual/nitrogen_pathways.json`, and its bounds are this project's own.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-FRATIO: How much of a Danish coastal bloom runs on regenerated nitrogen is not established here. The article pinned associates high f-ratios with productive systems dominated by large phytoplankton, and low ones with low-biomass, oligotrophic food webs.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-FSTATE: So the damage function may be not *f(load)* but *f(load, state)*, with the state term driven down by things that are not nutrients. The register holds each as a hypothesis:
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-GRANT: Granting the 69.6% entirely, here is what it has to pass through to become a statement about fedtemøg:
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-GROWN: Fedtemøg is algae, and algae are grown: the strands attach to stones, mussels or other algae and grow on until they tear loose (Danish Wikipedia). So nitrogen is on fedtemøg's path, and the open questions are *which* nitrogen and *what else* limits the growth — not whether nitrogen matters.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-INTRO: Companion to [NITROGEN.md](NITROGEN.md), which audits the nitrogen share where it is made. This page grants the share and asks what connects it to the outcome people name.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-JOIN: Put together, a share of nitrogen discharged is joined to an outcome on the shore. Nobody quoted here multiplies the two, but the argument invites the reader to. This page asks what connects them.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-JUXTA: **Put side by side:** the land-based supply roughly halved, and the 2024 September extent was the second largest registered. If load were the dominant control on oxygen depletion, halving it should have moved the extremes; these years do not show that it has — and two years are not a test. Section 9 says what would be.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-L1: A residual: measured-plus-modelled total minus modelled point sources minus modelled background, with a retention uncertainty of 16 percentage points in this project's register, which gives no source for it.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-L2: 10 of 20 enumerated pathways carry no number, among them deposition's organic fraction, submarine groundwater discharge and sediment regeneration.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-L3: Growth also needs light, phosphorus, a season and a surface to attach to, and uses nitrogen regenerated in place as well as nitrogen delivered; nothing here says how much of the growth the delivered share accounts for.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-L4: The strands tear loose, drift and strand, which takes retention, wind and a shore; no shore-condition series was found in any source this project surveyed.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-LAG: DCE attribute the drift in their nitrogen models to the time lag of nitrogen accumulated in the sediments; how long the lag is, is not established here.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-LINEAR: An apportionment is a linear instrument. It assumes the outcome is a weighted sum of the inputs, so that halving one input removes its share of the outcome. A self-amplifying loop is not a weighted sum. In one:
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-LOOP: There is a second structural problem, and it does the most damage to an apportionment: the system feeds itself. Simple, fast-replicating life grows on whatever is available; its respiration and decay draw the oxygen down; things that need oxygen die — fauna, and then everything else; the dead tissue remineralises, releasing the nutrients it was built from; and those nutrients feed the first step again, with less competition for them.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-LOOP-EASIER: Every turn of that loop makes the next easier, and the material driving it from the second turn on was **already in the bay**. It is not a delivery; nothing crossed a boundary an accounting could meter.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-MINORITY: Where most of a bloom's nitrogen is regenerated, attributing the bloom to a share of delivered nitrogen is a statement about the minority term: the rest was released by an earlier round of dying, not delivered that summer.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-MORE: So when the intervention underperforms, the instrument has one thing it can recommend: more of the same intervention. Not because that is the best reading of the evidence, but because it is the only reading the instrument can express.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-NEWREGEN: Marine biogeochemistry separates **new production**, running on nutrients newly supplied to the productive layer, from **regenerated production**, running on nutrients recycled in place; their ratio is the f-ratio.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-NOTFAILED: **It does not establish that nitrogen policy failed.** Necessary and insufficient are different findings, and the record is consistent with the second.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-NOTHOOK: **It does not establish that agriculture is off the hook.** Multiplying unknown fractions yields an unknown, not a small one. Agriculture is plausibly still the largest single nitrogen contributor, and the load is real.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-NOTSOURCE: The three share a property worth stating plainly: **none of them is a source.** A source apportionment cannot represent a lag, cannot represent temperature, and cannot represent the difference between a bay that can absorb a kilogram of nitrogen and a bay that cannot. They are not omitted because they were judged small. They are omitted because the instrument has no slot of that shape.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-ONLYFIRST: Only the first leaves the policy frame intact — it says the intervention is working and the answer is patience.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-OTHERS: For separate stormwater and for the stormwater-runoff reference the direct term is the *larger* of the two. Only raw sewage — the one stream that goes to treatment — is nitrogen-dominated.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-OUTCOME: **The outcome.** When DCE reported the September 2023 extent of oxygen depletion it was the second largest registered. September 2024's was 11,000 km², nearly 50% larger than 2023's, and again the second largest registered, exceeded only by 2002.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-PG-1: 1. **Route A carbon is conditional.** It requires a phototroph that is present, in a growing season, with light reaching it, and with phosphorus and silicon in supportive ratio. Nitrogen delivered in November grows little.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-PG-2: 2. **Route B carbon is unconditional.** It is already organic matter. It settles, it decays, and it consumes oxygen in the dark in December as well as in July.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-PG-3: 3. **Route B arrives where it is discharged.** Route A carbon is produced wherever the light and the season allowed, which may be nowhere near the shore that receives the consequence.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-PG-4: 4. **Route B arrives in pulses, on the flow threshold** — the same events that scour a basin and resuspend its accumulated sludge. Route A is a slower background.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-PRACTICAL: If nitrogen were the whole binding constraint, this would be a solved problem in principle: catch crops, wetlands, treatment upgrades and extractive aquaculture are available, and enough has already been deployed to roughly halve the land-based supply. Either the remaining reduction needed is far larger than anything currently proposed, or nitrogen is not the whole binding constraint.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-PUBLIC: In the public record this project pinned, that outcome is joined to agriculture's nitrogen:
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-REDUCTION: **The intervention.** DCE's national runoff report puts the reduction in nitrogen supply from land to Danish coastal waters between 1990 and 2018 at 51%, calculated on discharge-weighted mean annual concentrations.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-REGEN: **Sediment regeneration** is not a source at all in that apportionment, and has no number in this project's register either.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-ROUTEC: **Route C needs no input term.** A bay holds a standing stock of living tissue — macroalgae, eelgrass, fauna, biofilm. Kill it and that tissue becomes detritus without a single additional gram entering the system; a toxicant pulse, a hypoxic event, a sulphide pulse and a trawl all do this. It can explain why a bay produces more decaying material in a year when *less* was delivered to it.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-ROUTES: The iltsvind named in the same breath has at least three routes, and nitrogen is a necessary condition for one of them:
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-S1: - toxicants and metals that remove grazers and filter feeders, the organisms that would turn the subsidy into structure (E15, E10, K13);
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-S2: - physical disturbance of the bed, which removes the binding fauna and lets the bed move (D1, D8);
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-S3: - each hypoxic event, which kills the benthos and can make the next event cheaper;
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-S4: - the loss of eelgrass, which removes uptake and sediment stabilisation at once (K12, T4);
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-S5: - turbidity from a resuspending bed, which keeps the light from whatever might recolonise (D7, K11).
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-SCOPE: The 69.6% is agriculture's share of nitrogen **discharged to coastal waters by source** — the land-based waterborne term, nitrogen arriving at the coast through Danish streams and unmonitored catchments. Those are two rows of the 20 this project enumerates in NITROGEN.md:
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-SEASON: So for oxygen the two routes keep different calendars: nitrogen's effect on growth is highest in spring and summer and small in late autumn, while direct organic matter acts year-round and arrives whenever the rain falls.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-SENS: If they hold, each is a reason the same kilogram of nitrogen does more damage now than it did in 1990, and none appears in a source apportionment, because none is a source. **Nitrogen sensitivity would then be a derived property of a damaged system**, and the accounting treats it as a constant.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-STATE: The register's K12, D8 and T4 each describe a way the same load could do more damage now than before; none is a line in any account.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-SUBSIDY: Nitrogen is not a toxicant. It is a growth subsidy. What decides whether a subsidy produces eelgrass meadows or a bacterial mat is **which life is present and able to take it up**, and that is a property of the receiving system, not of the nitrogen.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-T1: Regress annual iltsvind extent on the land-based load, wind work over the stratified season, and the bottom-water temperature anomaly. No published regression of this kind was found in the sources this project holds.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-T2: The same regression with an interaction term, or simply: does a given load produce more hypoxia now than in 1990, holding weather constant?
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-T3: Two of the 10 empty rows have established methods — submarine groundwater discharge by radon or radium tracers, internal regeneration by benthic flux chambers — and both need new measurements.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-T4: Weight existing load figures by season and receiving-water stratification. Even a crude weighting beats the current implicit equal weight everywhere.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-T5: Fixed coastal cameras and a monthly index, year-round: a new instrument, and the only way the fedtemøg season stops being unfalsifiable in either direction.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-TEST: There is one empirical check on the nitrogen-dominant model, and Denmark has spent more than three decades running it.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-THREE: Three of the five need no new instrument, only series that exist; the other two need new measurements.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-TYPETAL-INTRO: The comparison can be made from the nutrient typetal in this project's monitoring register, which give each discharge type both an organic load (COD) and a nitrogen load. Route A's carbon is what that nitrogen could grow at Redfield stoichiometry — 5.68 g C per g N. Route B's carbon is what the water already carries — 0.375 g C per g COD.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-WARMING: DCE's notes: high water temperature promotes iltsvind, because oxygen consumption rises with temperature and oxygen's solubility falls. Temperature is not a line in a source apportionment.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-WEATHER: On DCE's own account the extremes follow the weather of the year, with load as a slower background. That is also why a load series computed to take the weather out cannot be read against them year by year.
CAUSATION.md.C-PC-CA-WIKI-AGRI: "Forekomsten af fedtemøg ved danske kyster skyldes især landbrugets udledning af kvælstof" — the same article

CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-ADD: An entry needs four things: the construction, the measurement it was held against, the result — a number wherever one is stored — and what the comparison licenses. If a check was run and passed, that belongs here too — a register of only failures would be a construction with its own selection problem. A new entry's number should come from a stored result, not from this page.
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-AGG: **Aggregation is where the failure hides.** `markoverskud` at national scale looks strong, and DCE's own report says the catchments did not all follow it. The water bodies look like a partition and carry no within-basket signal. **A pooled statistic can be tighter than any of its parts, because pooling averages over a coefficient that varies.**
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-CHECK3: **Discontinuity** — does `C` step on a date where `M` does not? A step with an administrative cause and no measured counterpart is the construction's non-physical component, and its size is measurable.
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-CHECK4: **Aggregation** — does the pooled relation look tighter than the stratified one? If so, the tightness is partly the pooling.
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-DIRECTION: **And a good sign licenses a claim about direction only.** "Nitrogen surplus fell and load fell" is supported nationally. "Cutting the surplus by `X` will cut the load by `0.7X`" needs a catchment's own coefficient, which this register does not hold.
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-HOLD: A constructed quantity — a residual, a norm product, a partition, a threshold, a model output — should be held against something that was measured, and **the relation between them stated as a number.**
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-HZ-R: **0 of 256 points are marine** (152 lake, 104 river)
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-HZ-V: withdrawn; the coverage was manufactured by proximity
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-MARK-R: nationally *"en meget stærk, signifikant lineær relation"*; per catchment, DCE themselves note that not all fjord catchments respond equally fast
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-MARK-V: **a strong national relation says nothing about any one catchment's coefficient.** The study that sizes the catchment coefficients could not be read here
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-METHOD: Method, and the audit of which parts of it survive their own rules: [statistical-methods](https://github.com/Jjokulian/statistical-methods).
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-NB-R: the flag's spread was measured over the agreeing variants only
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-NB-V: **the confidence statistic was conditioned on the selection it validated.** The rule now needs a majority and measures the spread over every variant. Since placed from resident-reported control points, standard error 14.3 m; the bundle adjustment still cannot tie it to the other sheets.
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-OURS: Ours are marked as ours. 2 of the 8 entries are this project's own constructions failing its own check, which is the point of keeping the register rather than a list of other people's errors.
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-PFT-R: each field is derived from chlorophyll, by the provider's own note in the files
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-PFT-V: **composition change at constant biomass is unrepresentable**
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-REGISTER: This page is a register of such comparisons this project has run. It is meant to be added to. Generated by `scripts/pages/constructed.py`, which reads each entry's result from stored data or rests it on a claim checked elsewhere on the site.
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-RHO-R: labels that carry no information score near one half, not zero
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-RHO-V: no raw value is readable on its own
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-SECCHI-R: seen-to-bottom on **24.3%** of readings where the water is 10 m deep or less, and **0.5%** deeper
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-SECCHI-V: right-censored, **44× more in shallow water**; any clarity-vs-depth comparison is partly the censoring
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-SIGN: **Sign is cheap and coefficient is not.** A relation that gets the direction right says nothing about whether its magnitude transfers from one stratum to another, and that is the failure a correlation cannot detect.
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-SIGNHIDES: **The coefficient and aggregation checks are where a construction can pass the sign check and still fail**, and a good sign hides that failure.
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-ST-R: **empty on 100% of 123,806 gratings and 94% of 85,816 wells**, while every one carries an elevation
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-ST-V: **an unfilled field, not an absent dimension.** The column exists, the survey happened, the value was never entered — so a contractor planning a bore knows where every lid is and not what one of them is
CONSTRUCTED.md.C-GC-C-WB-V: adds nothing beyond being a connected region of its size

CURRENTS.md.C-CS-BASELINE: Across all of them the southern Sound runs south **42%** of the time.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-BELT: *One caveat.* A low residual can also mean strong reversing flow with little net - which is what the Great Belt's 23 days is. The Belt has 2.7× Køge Bugt's mean speed: it moves water back and forth vigorously and averages out. Køge Bugt is slow *and* close to net-zero, and only the second of these is retention of the kind asked about here.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-DATA: Generated by `scripts/currents.py`. Currents from the Open-Meteo Marine API, hourly, 2022-2026; wind and rain from the ERA5 archive, hourly, 1995-2025. Both free and keyless.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-FEW: *Statistical honesty:* this rests on 145 event-hours, and every lag in the table was tested; the 0-hour and 12-hour results are both large. A longer current record would settle it.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-FLUSH: **In this field Køge Bugt takes 73 days to move water 20 km, and Aarhus Bugt takes 3.4** - a factor of 22. Køge Bugt has both the lowest mean speed in the set and the smallest residual: the water moves and ends up close to where it started.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-GRID: Open-Meteo computes its ocean currents at 0.08° (about 8 km), and the Øresund narrows to 4 km. A field that coarse cannot resolve the narrow straits, so what follows rests on ratios, signs and timings; the one figure that uses a speed - a flushing time in days - carries whatever speed error the field has.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-ILT-DEF: DCE call it iltsvind when the oxygen concentration is below 4 mg/l, and it develops at the bottom especially where the water column is stratified.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-ILT-OBS: In DCE's autumn surveys Aarhus Bugt was among the hardest-hit areas in October 2023 and still had sporadic moderate iltsvind late in November 2025; in both years DCE registered no iltsvind in Køge Bugt.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-INDEX: Best correlation is **r = 0.44 at a 24 hour window**, with sign agreement of only **61%** over 34,968 hours. The correlation falls away at the longer windows - 336 h gives 0.01, 504 h gives -0.05, 720 h gives -0.07.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-INDEX-PLAN: The plan was to regress the strait flow on a wind-driven Baltic filling index and, if it held, use the 31-year wind record to extend the current record. It does not hold.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-INDEX-READ: A 24-hour optimum is a local wind response, not a basin filling and draining over weeks. Either the multi-week Baltic memory is not the dominant control on the Sound, or this coarse product cannot see it. **The extension over the long wind record is not available on this data**, and everything about currents here is as long as the current record.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-INVERT: So the survey and this table rank different properties. Iltsvind is a concentration at the bottom, likeliest where the water is layered; the table ranks whether the water goes anywhere, and on that Køge Bugt is the extreme case in this set. A water can keep what it receives without registering iltsvind, and a survey that counts iltsvind would not show it.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-JOINT: These are the years the current record covers, and the numbers are small. The joint condition is rare - 8.1 hours a year in all. If transport toward Køge Bugt happens in so few hours, an annual-average accounting cannot represent it, and neither can monitoring that samples on a calendar.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-LAG: **12 hours after an overflow-scale event, southward transport runs 59% - +17 points above baseline.** In the wind record the hours after such rain are the westerly ones: 12 hours later the wind is from the south-west or west 62% of the time.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-LAG-READ: So the transport is neither the simple claim nor its refutation but a lag: the discharge happens under northward flow, and the flow reverses about half a day later, in the westerly weather that follows the rain.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-METRIC: The measure is the **residual current divided by the mean speed** - how much of the water's motion actually goes somewhere. A speed error common to both cancels out of that ratio. The flushing time in days is the distance over the residual alone, so it keeps whatever speed error the field has at that point.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-NEED-DENSITY: **Density.** The Sound lies between the Kattegat, at more than 30 PSU, and the Baltic, at around 7 PSU, and its surface stream is often northbound from the Baltic. One current per point cannot show whether a plume and the water beneath it are moving differently.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-NEED-FIELD: **A current field that resolves the straits.** Copernicus Marine publishes a Baltic reanalysis at 1 nautical mile resolution. Everything here would be worth redoing on it, the retention result first.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-NEED-LONGER: **A longer current record.** The wind index failed, so the current record cannot be extended backwards, and the event counts stay small.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-NEED-TRACK: **Particle tracking.** Retention is a summary statistic. Where material released off Amager ends up needs trajectories, which need the field above.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-PEAKS: The peak speed the field reaches at each point is below. The script sets these beside peak speeds it records as published, but no source for those is held, so that comparison is not used here.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-RAIN-NORTH: **During the rain, the water runs north**, and the harder it rains the more so: at overflow-scale rainfall, southward transport is 18 points below the baseline.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-RAIN-WIND: The wind record does not show south-westerlies that would explain this simply: over 31 years, in the hours of overflow-scale rain the wind is from the south-west or west 33% of the time, against 41% of all hours. What drives the Sound north in those hours is not established here.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-SEASONS: Over the 31 years of the Copenhagen weather record, rain intense enough to overflow a combined sewer (at least 10 mm in 6 hours) comes mostly in **Jun, Jul, Aug**, 4.2-5.1 hours a year in each, against at most 3.0 in any other month. Total rainfall varies much less, 38-72 mm a month. Wave-driven bed resuspension is most frequent in **Oct, Nov, Dec, Jan**.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-SEQUENCE: If the overflow's solids settle where they are discharged, the seasons line up into a sequence: delivery in the rain season into the most retentive water in this set, a residence time of months, and resuspension in the gales. The seasons and the flushing time are computed here; that the discharged material settles in Køge Bugt and is lifted again later is not measured.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-SYDFYN: **Det Sydfynske Øhav** comes out at 8.7 days - retentive, but far from Køge Bugt - and DCE's surveys found iltsvind there in both years. On this evidence the two bays are not the same case. A field this coarse cannot resolve an archipelago, so this is weak evidence either way.
CURRENTS.md.C-CS-TEST: Køge Bugt lies south of Copenhagen, and the residual current at the southern Sound point runs toward 43°, away from it. So the claim can only hold in particular hours: the hours in which the city overflows would have to be hours in which the water runs south. The rain record and the current record overlap for 35,064 hours, so this can be tested directly.

DATA_QUEUE.md.C-DQ-Q-ACCOUNT: *The access text names a registration, an account, a login or a token that the queue does not count as held.*
DATA_QUEUE.md.C-DQ-Q-AGG: Under the rule such a source is used as somebody's aggregate of a measurement, never as the measurement.
DATA_QUEUE.md.C-DQ-Q-BLOCKED: *The access text says not public, request-only, FOI, provisioned, unverified or without a download — or matches no tier word at all. Entries recording data confirmed not to exist are here too.*
DATA_QUEUE.md.C-DQ-Q-COUNT: **148 sources**, from `data_sources.json` and `data_sources_2.json`. `data_sources_3.json`, also part of the register, is not read by this queue, so its entries are in none of the tiers below.
DATA_QUEUE.md.C-DQ-Q-DF: **Dataforsyningen** — an API token, which `scripts/terraincheck.py` reads to fetch the national elevation model
DATA_QUEUE.md.C-DQ-Q-HELD: *An ODA topic, or a service behind the Dataforsyningen token: behind a credential this project holds. Some are already on disk: the ODA extracts `kemi`, `ctd`, `lys` and `maaledybde`.*
DATA_QUEUE.md.C-DQ-Q-INDEX: Counted by that keyword reading of each entry's spatial and aggregation text; `?` means the text matched no keyword, not that the source has no index.
DATA_QUEUE.md.C-DQ-Q-ODA: **ODA / Overfladevandsdatabasen** — an email login, and a scripted SOAP extract in `scripts/oda_client.py`
DATA_QUEUE.md.C-DQ-Q-OPEN: *The access text reads as open — an open or direct download, a service asking no key or authentication, or an open licence — and names nothing that puts it in another tier.*
DATA_QUEUE.md.C-DQ-Q-PULSCLOSED: `PULS` is one whose data exists and is closed: the register records it as not public, reached through an organisation's IT coordinator.
DATA_QUEUE.md.C-DQ-Q-PURPOSE: The source register records what exists; this page sorts its entries by friction: what can be downloaded now, what sits behind a credential this project holds, what needs a registration it has not made, and what the register's access text does not show to be reachable.
DATA_QUEUE.md.C-DQ-Q-ROWS: In each tier below, entries are ordered by how many hypotheses they unlock. *Indexed by* is read from the entry's spatial and aggregation text by keyword: a position, a **region**, both (*mixed*), or `?` where neither matched. *What it is* is the entry's name, shortened where long.
DATA_QUEUE.md.C-DQ-Q-RULE: The rule: a source is carried at the resolution it was taken — a position, a time, and where it exists a depth — and not at an administrative unit such as a water body, a catchment, a municipality or a sub-basin. This page flags each source by what it is indexed by; it does not enforce the rule.
DATA_QUEUE.md.C-DQ-Q-TIERS: Each entry's tier is read from its access text by keyword, in this order: an ODA topic, or a source that names Dataforsyningen, is *held*; words for not public, request-only, FOI, provisioning, unverified or no download make it *blocked*; words for a registration, an account, a login or a token make it *account*; words for an open or key-free download make it *open*; and an entry that matches none of these is counted as *blocked*. Because the account words are tested before the open ones, an access text saying that no login or no registration is needed is counted as *account*. The tiers have not been checked by hand entry by entry, and the note under the credentials shows where they go wrong for the Copernicus entries.
DATA_QUEUE.md.C-DQ-Q-TILF: A region-indexed source can still be the one to fetch: the monthly nutrient input to the sea, `ODA-TILFOERSEL`, is given per marine reference polygon, and the register records the stream stations behind it as available separately, in `ODA-STOFTRANSPORT`.
DATA_QUEUE.md.C-DQ-Q-UNCOUNTED: The queue counts only these as held. This project's fetch scripts also read Copernicus Data Space client credentials (`scripts/fetch_satellite.py`) and Copernicus Marine credentials (`scripts/fetch_cmems.py`) from this machine, so the Copernicus entries are counted in tiers that say otherwise: `CDSE-SENTINEL1` `CMEMS-BAL-BGC` `CMEMS-BAL-PHY` `CMEMS-NWS-WAV` as *account*; `CMEMS-BAL-WAV` as *blocked*.
DATA_QUEUE.md.C-DQ-Q-UNLOCKS: *Unlocks* lists the hypotheses an entry names that no entry in an easier tier also names — a crude priority signal, and meant to be.
DATA_QUEUE.md.C-DQ-Q-VALUE: Friction is not value. The tiers say what is easy to reach, and each register entry's hypotheses say what it would serve; they are different questions, and this page answers only the first.
DATA_QUEUE.md.C-DQ-Q-WB: **What a water body actually is, if it is anything, is a question to be answered from the data rather than assumed by the schema.** Put the observations on the map with their own coordinates and times, see which move together, and check every proxy against an unrelated one. The administrative polygon is then an overlay to be tested against — not a container to pour things into.
DATA_QUEUE.md.C-DQ-Q-WHY: The reason is in [OBSERVING.md](OBSERVING.md): in bathing-water quality at stations with a long record, once the national year-to-year swing is removed, variation between water bodies is **7.9%** of the whole, and between two stations in the same water body 4.1% of the wobble in one is shared with the other. A source already summed into those polygons would carry the unit back in, and everything computed from it would inherit it.

DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-AREAS: Extracted flooded area: Bispebjerg 2.22 km², KBH Vest 1.39, Amager 1.18, Ladegårdsåen 0.42, Nørrebro 0.36, Østerbro 0.10, Indre By 0.04.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-AXIS: **Gotcha:** asked in WFS `1.0.0` this server returns `EPSG:4326` as `[lon, lat]`, and `1.1.0` flips the axis order. `scripts/common.py` detects which arrived rather than trusting either.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-BGV: **`bgv_type` decoding** is in `data/manual/codelists.json`, from Miljøstyrelsen's [Datateknisk anvisning DP02 v4 (2024)](https://mst.dk/media/bnkdidho/dta-dp02-rbu-version-4-2024.pdf). Its table of the data PULS requires for combined-sewer overflows defines `OV`, `OS`, `OF`, `OK`, `Bypass` and `Skybrud`; its list for separate-sewer outfalls defines `SE` (separate rainwater) and `SF` (separate rainwater with a detention basin), which make up 487 of our 680 points.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-BORROW: **Lending a clock, with a caveat.** If a station-day is one moment — which is assumed, not checked — the clock can be lent from `kemi` to `ctd`, the only route in the data held to putting a time on oxygen at depth. `scripts/depth_clock.py` does it through `scripts/clock.py`, lending only a `kemi` clock that is an observed time: 4,688,007 CTD oxygen measurements are placed that way, and 2,454,520 have no usable clock to borrow. The first count is taken after the script's quality filters and the second before them, so the two are not shares of one population.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-BOTTOM: In `maaledybde`, `BundDybde_m` reaches 2300 m at `Læsø rende`, where the station's 510 readings have a median of 22.565 m, and 292.3 m at a station named `Hirtshals 15 m`, whose readings have a median of 17.5 m.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-CENSOR: **Censoring hidden behind column names that do not say so.** `ResultatAttribut` is `<` on 85,035 `kemi` rows, where `Resultat` holds *the detection limit, not the measurement* — read as a value it biases the parameter high.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-CKAN: The city's CKAN catalogue answers at `https://admin.opendata.dk/api/3/action/package_search?q=organization:city-of-copenhagen`; the same path on `www.opendata.dk` answered `404`.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-CLIP: Layers here are national, so `fetch_wfs.py` clips them — by `komm_navn` where that column exists, otherwise by bounding box; the layers without a municipality column would come back empty without the bounding-box fallback.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-CLOCKPY: Every analysis that places a water-chemistry sample in time takes the instant from `scripts/clock.py`, which returns one UTC instant or says why there is none.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-CORNER: So a modelled depth at a street corner is never checked against the water actually standing there.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-DETLIMIT: The same chapter asks for values below the detection limit to be reported as measured, not as zero or as the limit with `<`. Yet 72,026 of the 1,153,832 nutrient, TOC and POC rows in `kemi` carry `<` — though which rows were sampled under this chapter the archive cannot say, since `TekniskAnvisningAnvendt` carries one value throughout.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-DHM: `scripts/terraincheck.py` fetches the national elevation model's terrain (`dhm_terraen`) from Dataforsyningen's WCS, `https://api.dataforsyningen.dk/dhm_wcs_DAF`, with a token kept on this machine and at the resolution it asks for, to check the 2012 flood sheets against the ground.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-DP02-CALIB: Miljøstyrelsen's technical standard (dTA DP02) calibrates a model on measurement *at the overflow structure*: at least five clearly separable overflow events must be in the measured data.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-EMPTYCOLS: **Columns that carry nothing.** `TekniskAnvisningAnvendt` is single-valued across every row of the three extracts that carry it, and `Afsluttet` across both that carry it, so neither can be used to filter for protocol compliance.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-ENUMS: `scripts/enums.py` counts every distinct value of every column of `kemi` and `ctd`, and `scripts/ds_facts.py` counts the traps below over every row of all four, because reading the top few values of a column is how a rare sentinel survives.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-FLOOD-PDFS: It is published as **7 raster PDFs** — amager, bispebjerg, indre-by, kbhvest, ladegaardsaaen, norrebro, osterbro — from 8 to 30 MB each, an orthophoto with the depth bands painted over it. The dataset record says the calculations are from 2012, and each sheet's title puts the event in 2010.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-FLOOD-UNUSABLE: This is the most important thing in this catalogue and the least usable. Where rain ponds in Copenhagen was calculated at municipal scale and published as an image: no coordinates this project could use, no vector extents, no depth values - so nothing can be overlaid, intersected or queried until each sheet is placed and read.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-FLOOD-WHAT: `Oversvømmelsesscenarier for vandoplande` on opendata.dk: flood scenarios from the city's cloudburst plans for each water catchment, based on calculations, for a 100-year event, banded `0.05-0.1 m` / `0.1-0.2 m` / `0.2-0.5 m` / `0.5-1 m` / `1-2 m` / `>2 m`. Which model produced them, over what terrain, is not stated.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-FLOWINPUT: It is also the input for **modelling where rain flows**: fill the terrain's sinks, compute flow direction and accumulation, and surface flow paths and ponding depressions come out directly, rather than being inferred from the plan.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-HOFOR: The utility. Its page for contractors sends requests for pipe information to LER, and `hofor.dk` is used here as a citation source for the manual register of structures, not as a data source.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-INTEGRATED: **Sample type decides what a depth means.** The technical instruction's sampling chapter ([Kap. 5](https://ecos.au.dk/fileadmin/ecos/Fagdatacentre/Marin/TA_NOVA_1998/Kap05.doc)) prescribes integrated samples over 0–10 m, over 0–25 m, or down to the depth of the photic zone. In `kemi`, 2,261 of the 9,734 `Dybdeintegreret prøve` rows carry a nominal depth of 3 m or less and will enter a surface filter as though they were point measurements. An integral is not a measurement at its midpoint.

Everything marked **fetched** is pulled by the scripts in `scripts/` and lands in `data/raw/`. Generated by `scripts/pages/data_sources.py`: every count is read from the fetch manifest or a derived file, and every statement opens what it rests on.

DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-KBH-FETCHED: Layer names come from `?service=WFS&version=1.1.0&request=GetCapabilities`. The 21 this project fetches are listed, with their feature counts and properties, in `data/raw/_manifest.json`.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-KBH-SERVER: `https://wfs-kbhkort.kk.dk/k101/ows` answered an anonymous capabilities request on 2026-09-11 with 483 layers.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-KBH-TABLE: What each fetched layer is, from the title, note and properties the fetch records for it, and why it matters here:
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-KF-CTD: **CTD temperature, conductivity, pressure** ([Kap. 1](https://ecos.au.dk/fileadmin/ecos/Fagdatacentre/Marin/TA_NOVA_1998/Kap01.doc)): calibration lives in the sensor's own coefficients, checked against reference measurements; the word *faktor* occurs 0 times in the chapter, so **no post-hoc multiplicative factor is described.** Yet 1,280 temperature rows carry a factor other than one, up to 80×, and 3,926 salinity rows, up to 2346.15× — with no basis in the instruction.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-KF-FLUOR: **Fluorescence** ([Kap. 2](https://ecos.au.dk/fileadmin/ecos/Fagdatacentre/Marin/TA_NOVA_1998/Kap02.doc)): **not** bias compensation. The instruction states that a fluorescence signal *"kan derfor ikke direkte omsættes til en pigment koncentration"*, whatever the manufacturers' software reports, and that a varying ratio of fluorescence to chlorophyll *"[er] ikke et udtryk for instrument problemer"* — so the factor is a calibration against measured chlorophyll, and large factors can be correct. 156,974 of its 6,783,790 factored rows (2.3%) fall outside 0.5–2, to a maximum of 201×. **Do not filter fluorescence on this column.**
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-KF-OXYGEN: **Oxygen** ([Kap. 4](https://ecos.au.dk/fileadmin/ecos/Fagdatacentre/Marin/TA_NOVA_1998/Kap04.doc)): instrument bias compensation. The electrode profile is checked against a Winkler titration on a bottle from 1 m, and if they disagree by more than 0.3 mg O₂/l every value in the profile is multiplied by the ratio of the two. Where the Winkler bottle fell inside a gradient, the profile is corrected instead by the mean factor from profiles measured the same day at other stations — so some corrected oxygen carries a calibration derived at a different station.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-KFAKTOR: **`KorrektionsFaktor` is not one thing.** In `ctd`, `KorrigeretResultat` equals `OriginalResultat × KorrektionsFaktor`, to within the rounding of the stored value, on 53,708,047 of the 53,710,760 rows carrying all three, and not on the other 2,713 — so a wrong factor corrupts the value silently and by construction. But what the factor *means* differs per parameter, and the technical instructions say so:
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-LEGEND: The legend is masked before the depth is read, or its swatches would count as flooding; its position moves between sheets, so it is located from the text layer.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-LER-POLICY: This project does not query it: an inquiry is for an intended excavation, and this project digs nothing. It is documented as a drop-in slot for those who hold access — see [IF_YOU_HAVE_THE_DATA.md](IF_YOU_HAVE_THE_DATA.md).
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-LER-RULE: The utilities' pipe information is requested here by a dig inquiry, made as a user logged in with MitID; LER's page for excavators gives the owners 2 hours to answer, and digging waits until all of them have.

DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-NO-INVERTS: This is the limit on the 3D ambition: **none of the open sources in this catalogue gives surveyed invert levels for Copenhagen's sewers.** Depths in this project come from what the plan documents state in prose, and are labelled as claims.

They are stored in `data/manual/observations.geojson`, hand-collected, never overwritten by a fetch script.

DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-PULS: The national point-source database, run by Danmarks Miljøportal. Every rain-dependent discharge is reported in it with its master data, and its discharged volumes of water and substance are to be determined every year; DP02 grades how each volume was found, from a simple mass balance to measurement at the structure.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-PULS-ACCESS: Access to PULS goes through the IT coordinator of one's own organisation, as DP02's system overview has it; this project holds no such access and reads the public extract.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-PULS-EXTRACT: The public spildevandsdata extract carries 4,217 combined-sewer overflow structures and 16,185 separate stormwater outfalls.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-RANGE: A physical range check will not catch a bad factor: 0.5 applied to 18 °C gives 9 °C, an unremarkable Danish sea temperature that happens to be wrong.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-RECOVER: The pages *cite* the klima_id in their titles and body text ("`A3.3` Regnvandsledning i Bispebjerg Bakke, `BIR 7.5`"). `build_registry.py` recovers the link by scanning for ids that actually exist in the geometry, which stops stray tokens inventing matches. The recovered mapping is a **reconstruction, not an official crosswalk** — treat it as such.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-SCALES: The sheets are at **a different scale each**, with scale denominators from 7,528 (Nørrebro) to 28,737 (KBH Vest), and scale bars of 500 m or 1000 m. Each sheet carries a real text layer, so the bar length is read, not guessed.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-SECCHI: In `maaledybde`, `SigtTilBund` is true on 26,380 Secchi readings, meaning the disc reached the bottom and the water was clearer than the number says. `SigtDybdeMedVandkikkert` marks 6,104 readings taken through a water telescope, a different instrument.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-SENTINELS: **Sentinels, undeclared — and one announced but absent.** In `lys`, the migration note on 1,857,147 rows says `YIntercept` was set to `9999999` because the source lacked it; on 1,854,698 of them the column is blank, and it holds `9999999` on 0 rows of the extract. In `kemi`, `GennemsnitsDybde_m` is exactly `99` on 4,332 rows, with nothing on the row to say whether that depth was measured.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-STARTKLOK: `Startklok` has a value on every genuine `kemi` row — the 22 rows without one are fragments of a broken note field — and ODA offers no clock field at all for `ctd`, `lys` or `maaledybde`.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-TYPETAL: The same document's table 1 gives the concentrations to assume for overflow water (BI₅ 30, COD 180, Tot-N 12, Tot-P 2.0 mg/l), type values derived from monitoring of water from combined systems — which is how a volume becomes a load.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-UNITS: **Units are per row, not per parameter. 14 of 146 `kemi` parameters carry more than one.** `Orthophosphat` is 565 rows in µg/l against 353 in mg/l. Integrated primary production splits 5,068 mg/(m²·d) against 62,831 mg/(m³·d), *per area against per volume*, which cannot be reconciled without a depth. `Klorofyl a` is 185,313 rows in µg/l and 1 in mg/l — and no range filter can catch that, because a plausible mg/l value is also a plausible µg/l value. **Check `Enhed` on every row.** Oxygen, saturation and total nitrogen are single-valued throughout, which is luck rather than a guarantee.
DATA_SOURCES.md.C-DS-UTC: **What the instruction asks for and the archive does not deliver.** The nutrient chapter ([Kap. 6](https://ecos.au.dk/fileadmin/ecos/Fagdatacentre/Marin/TA_NOVA_1998/Kap06.doc)) lists *"Prøvetagningsdato og tidspunkt i UTC"* among the station data to report, and wherever that can be tested the archive's times are not UTC. `scripts/clockzone.py` compares every station with itself at each summer-time change and finds Danish wall-clock times from the early two-thousands, wall-clock times with the summer or winter offset *added* before that, and filled-in defaults on 27,934 of 129,913 sampling visits, with 17,836 more from suppliers whose convention is mixed.
