SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-G3: **The trigger catches events.** Passes if the sampler fires on the rising limb and fills bottles across the storm, unattended, three times; fails if it fires on noise, or misses the events the rain record says happened.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-G4: **The panel discriminates *here*.** Passes if the sterol ratio and host markers separate this catchment's slurry from its sewage effluent and from its soil; fails otherwise — **and this is the one that kills the national design.** If the end members are not separable in one Danish catchment, twelve pairs will not fix it.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-G5: **The chain closes.** Passes if a reading taken at a culvert appears in a public series with its calibration state attached; fails if anything in the path needs a person to copy a file.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-HYPS: The point of writing them out is that each makes a different prediction about the same measurements, so the data can pick. They are hypotheses, not findings: this page asserts none of them.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-I-CHASE: **Storm-chasing bias.** Triggers are set in advance and left alone. An operator who decides which storms are interesting has destroyed the sample.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-I-ENDS: **Unmeasured end members.** If the slurry in *these* tanks was never sampled, every fraction is a guess with a decimal point on it.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-I-FOUL: **Fouled sensors reading confidently.** Servicing schedule and co-location against a reference instrument, or the continuous tier is decoration. This is [`X16`](EXPERIMENTS.md).
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-I-MATCH: **Catchments matched on the wrong thing.** If the high-density catchments are also the sandy ones, the design has confounded exactly what it set out to separate — and the pairing has to be published so somebody else can say so.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-INVALID: Written down in advance, so that none of them can be found afterwards as an excuse:
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-L-SHIP: **Ship time is not in it.** The autumn benthic extension and anything offshore needs a vessel and an institution, and this page provides neither.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-LEAD: **The experiment that would end the argument, written so that both sides can commit to it before it runs.**
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-NAV: [SENSING.md](SENSING.md) constructs the instrument: the fingerprint meant to separate a pig from a person from a road, and the two-tier network that could carry it.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-NOTSETTLE: **Does not settle.** What the arriving material then does in the sea: that is the next experiment and it is harder. Nor anything about constituents outside the analysed list. Nor the marine oxygen question, which has [its own designs](EXPERIMENTS.md).
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-NOWASTE: **No stage is wasted if the next one is never funded.** Stage `0` is a real series from a real stream. Stage `1` is a publishable methods result either way. Stage `2` is a regional finding. That property is the reason to stage it like this rather than to write one large proposal that has to be accepted whole.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-PERMISSION: The stream measurements need a landowner's permission at each culvert, and the end-member samples need the farms and plants that hold them to agree.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-PHASES: [SENSING.md](SENSING.md) lists what to buy: the node, the sampler, the shared kit and the laboratory panel. No price is given there or here: the design says what to buy, and a supplier's quotation says what it costs. The laboratory is a cost per bottle and the sensors a purchase made once, so the bottles are the line that grows with the design, and the one that cannot be economised without losing the attribution the design exists for.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-POC: **One pair of catchments, one spreading season, and a deliberately narrow question.** The distinction matters: a single pair cannot answer whether the payload reaches Danish water — the sample is one pair and the result would be a number people fight over. What it *can* do is establish that the method works, which is what has to be true before anybody buys 24 of anything.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-R0: These are the whole point of the page. A rule written afterwards is a story.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-R1: **The bypass is accepted** if faecal-marker load in the spreading window exceeds the autumn control window by a factor stated in advance at **two thirds or more of the high-density sites**, and the effect scales with livestock density across the twelve pairs.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-R2: **The soil reactor is accepted** if marker loads in the two windows are indistinguishable, by a criterion stated in advance, at the sites the first rule looks at, and nitrate is the only determinand that moves.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-R3: **The regime is accepted** if the effect is present at some sites and absent at others *and* is predicted by soil, drainage or antecedent wetness better than by density.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-R4: **The result is published whichever way it falls**, in full, with the raw series — and the pre-registration says so before the money is spent. **If the soil reactor wins, this project's own emphasis was wrong and the page saying so will carry that sentence.**
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-R5: **No composite index is reported without the series it came from**, and no residual is named after a source. That is the failure this whole site documents; reproducing it here would be unforgivable.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-RAIN: And the events can be counted in advance. In the hourly rainfall record used elsewhere in this project, over Copenhagen, 1995–2025, these are the days of each February–April season with at least a given daily total, over its 31 seasons:
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-RC-CUST: **Custody.** Somebody has to keep the archive, the calibration histories and the pre-registration for as long as the series runs, and that is a job rather than a server.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-RC-LAB: **Laboratory.** The tier-two bottles are paid for one analysis at a time, and are the only line that cannot be economised without losing the attribution.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-RC-SERV: **Servicing.** A sensor that nobody visits produces confident wrong numbers, which is worse than no sensor.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-RC-SO: So: **a purchase to find out, and salaries to keep knowing.** The recurring part is the one a proposal has to be honest about, because it is the one that gets cut and takes the series with it.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-RECUR: **Do not mistake the hardware for the programme.** Hardware is bought once, and saying that it is the cost is how these schemes die:
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-S0: **Stage `0` — one node**: a single stream, no sampler. Does the hardware survive and report?
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-S1: **Stage `1` — proof of concept**: one pair, one season, one sampler. Does the method discriminate, here?
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-S2: **Stage `2` — regional**: pairs in more than one region, both windows. Is the effect visible at all, and how variable?
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-S3: **Stage `3` — the experiment**: twelve pairs, two years. Which of the 3 hypotheses is right?
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-S4: **Stage `4` — the network**: every outlet that reaches the sea. The same answer everywhere, permanently.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-SAMPLE: **That is the sample size, and it is the reason the design works.** A sampler that fires on days of 5 mm or more would see a median of 9 such days in a spreading season — a day being a UTC day, so a storm that spans two days counts twice — enough for a paired comparison within a single year, at a single site.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-SETTLES: **Settles.** Whether the payload reaches the water, in what quantity, in what season, under what conditions, and whose it is — measured rather than modelled, at the point where inland water becomes coastal water. Whether the spreading calendar is visible in a stream. Whether the account's single channel is missing a second one, and by roughly how much.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-STAGED: **A staged path, with a decision at each step:**
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-UNSCOREABLE: **Some of it cannot be bought at all.** 42 of the 166 mechanisms in the register cannot be tested with any source this project surveyed, because the deciding measurement is in none of them; money buys the instrument, not the record it should have been collecting.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-W-ANY: **Anyone at all**: hold the pre-registration to its publication rule when the result is inconvenient.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-W-ASSOC: **A local association or a school**: a pair — one high-density catchment and its match — which is a whole experiment in miniature.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-W-MUNI: **A municipality or a water utility**: the samplers and the laboratory line, which is the half that needs an institution.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-W-ONE: **One person with a culvert and a soldering iron**: a node, a year of a real series from one stream, and the demonstration that it works.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-W-UNI: **A university group**: the end-member sampling and the isotope work, and the pre-registration that makes the rest admissible.
SETTLE.md.C-SS-T-WHYEND: **Why it would end the argument rather than extend it.** The disputed agricultural share is a modelled residual. This produces a measured quantity, at named places, on dates, with the raw series published and the decision rule fixed in advance — so the result is available to somebody who does not trust either party. **That is the kind of number that can end a disagreement.**

SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-ANALOGY: A sewer network need not be more evenly behaved than a river network, and this register's storage is not.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-BASINS: Material caught in basin sediment can be carried out when a high flow scours it. Removing it in advance is an operating procedure, not construction.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-COMBINED: Rain that falls on a Copenhagen street mostly does not go to a river. It goes into the same pipe as the sewage, and when that pipe fills, the mixture leaves through an overflow structure without passing a treatment works.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-DELIVERY: Delivery, on the city's own expected-in-service dates: **56 km by the end of 2025**, 148 km scheduled through 2038, and 76 km with no date at all.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-DESIGN: The city's flood scenarios for the cloudburst plan are for a 100-year event. A skybrudsvej carries water only when the pipes are already overwhelmed; ordinary heavy rain still goes into the combined pipe.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-DIFFERENT: The surface network answers the flood risk to the city, which is a different problem with a different design storm.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-EVERYDAY: The everyday-rain component is the green roads and the infiltration - 61 km and 156 ha respectively - against 3,447 ha that needs disconnecting.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-FAT: A grease separator sits at the business, so this is regulation and enforcement, not construction.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-FIRST: Which is the case for doing the cheap thing first. Instrument the tail, find out whether a handful of structures dominates the load the way a handful dominates the volume, and the argument about what to build next becomes an argument with evidence in it.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-LAR: So between 1.4% (confirmed in use) and 4.5% (registered) of the relevant area has been taken off the pipe. That is a statement about scale, not a criticism of infiltration as a technique.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-LAR-WHAT: The other route off the combined system is local infiltration - soakaways, rain gardens, green roofs - each of which takes a specific area of roof or pavement off the sewer. The city registers them individually, with the disconnected area in square metres.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-MEASURE: Flow-proportional samplers on the largest 13 structures. That is videnniveau 5, the best method in Miljøstyrelsen's own hierarchy, at 30% uncertainty instead of 135% for a simple mass balance.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-MIDDLE: The middle row is the finding, and the category's own name says it. Separating the pipes within a catchment and joining them again upstream of the overflow changes what happens inside the block and nothing at the outfall.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-NET: By impervious area: combined drops from 3,447 ha to 3,169 ha, but 197 ha of that goes into the reconnected category. **Net area actually leaving the combined system: about 80 ha, or 2.3%.**
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-OFTEN: Overflows are counted in years, not centuries: in the national layer, the 2,541 combined-sewer overflow structures that fill in the count report a median of 6 overflows a year.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-PLAN-INTRO: Every catchment carries both a current sewer type and a planned one. Of the **300 combined catchments**:
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-PLASTIC: A similar concentration is documented for plastic in rivers: of 100,887 river outlets in a global model, 1656 account for 80% of the plastic emitted to the ocean ([Meijer et al., *Science Advances*, 2021](https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.aaz5803)).
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-PLUMBING: It is a fact about plumbing, not about agriculture, nutrients or nitrogen.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-PULS: PULS already holds the number of overflows a year. No flow rate is recorded at all, which is a decision about the format, not a limit of the instruments.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-RATIO: **168 km of surface conveyance against 71 km of pipe - 2.4 to 1.** The idea is not missing from Copenhagen's plan; it is the plan's dominant form. Lengths are those of `scripts/conveyance.py`, the one length table for this layer.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-RECONNECT: separated inside the catchment - **and reconnected to the combined system.** The rain is still in the sewage pipe by the time it reaches an overflow.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-REGISTER: The national register holds **19,665 rain-dependent discharge points** across 97 municipalities (680 of them inside the Copenhagen clip used elsewhere here). Only **1,328** of them carry a recorded basin volume; the other 18,337 have the field empty. Among those that do have a number, the distribution is extreme:
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-ROW-SEPARATE: 13 of the 300 combined catchments are planned for it.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-SHARE: **90.7% of the city's population equivalent, and 81.4% of its impervious area, sits on a combined system.** That is 3,447 hectares of roof and pavement whose runoff is, by design, mixed with sewage before it can go anywhere.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-SOURCE: Generated by `scripts/solutions.py` from Københavns Kommune's own catchment and cloudburst layers and the national overflow register.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-SOURCES: Sources: `sp_kloakoplande`, `lar_registreringer` and `skp_veje_tunneller_kk` from Københavns Kommune's WFS; `vp3_basis_2019_punkt_rbu_udl` from Miljøgis; the national register `punkt_rbu_udl`; the national overflow layer from spildevandsdata.dk. Typetal and knowledge-level provenance in `data/manual/monitoring.json`. Lengths are computed from the geometries by `scripts/conveyance.py`; areas and volumes are the values the publishers recorded.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-SPLIT: So the answer to *how fast* splits in two. **The measurement problem could be addressed within a season**, and until it is, nobody can say which of the slow interventions is worth the money. **The infrastructure problem cannot be fixed quickly by anyone**, and the sewer plan on the books leaves most combined catchments combined.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-SURFACE-WHAT: The cloudburst plan is not mostly pipes. It is mostly surface: streets reshaped into channels, green roads, squares that hold water - rainwater rivers at city scale, designed and partly built.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-TAIL: **13 structures hold 24% of the recorded volume.** The largest is 42,000 m³; the median is 250 m³. That is a heavy tail.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-TAILARG: Put those together. The stored volume is concentrated in a few structures; the concentrations describe the typical residential case and leave out the discharge types the report itself expects to carry more. A national load built as volume times typetal therefore rests on the typical case. Whether the load, like the volume, is concentrated in a few structures is not measured.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-TIMESCALES: The timescales below are this page's estimates, from what each step involves - equipment, an operating procedure, regulation, construction - not from any costed plan.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-TRACTABLE: The concentration in section 5 cuts both ways. It is what makes a typical-case estimate weak, and it is also what makes the problem tractable: if a few structures dominate, a few interventions cover most of it.
SOLUTIONS.md.C-CS-S-TYPETAL: The national concentrations for hazardous substances in these discharges - the typetal - come from **6 combined-overflow stations and 5 stormwater stations** in catchments chosen to represent households and residential areas. They cover only discharges without prior treatment such as settling in basins, and not industrial areas or heavily trafficked roads, which the report says typically carry more; and the report finds that a significant share of the adsorbing substances is caught in basin sediment.

hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-ACTUAL: Use the **actual** (*aktuel*) series, never the climate-normalised one: normalisation is a model applied to the total, and its method changed with SR353 — the new method conserves mass, so that over the whole period from 1990 the normalised and the actual load are equal, while by the old method the normalised values ran 1% above the actual over 1990–2017. It moves T by itself between vintages and would contaminate the third failure mode.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-BLICHER: The field balance behind it is computed as Blicher-Mathiesen and colleagues (2015) describe.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-BOX: Nor whether *Denmark* is a closed box: the national catchment layer names the transboundary unit outright, and whether the account carries a term for what flows in from across the border is not established — the pinned SR353 does not mention Germany. A partition that balances is still a partition of a quantity whose boundary was assumed.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-CIRCULAR: A farming statistic is an input to the model that generates the diffuse load over the ungauged part of the country, and its correlation with that load is then reported as evidence — class `7`, model-as-datum, in [the taxonomy of data-stream errors](https://github.com/Jjokulian/statistical-methods#7b-rate-a-data-stream-by-the-errors-it-can-contain). This does not show the attribution is wrong. It shows that Figur 6.7 D cannot be what shows it is right.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-CTD: `data/raw/oda/ctd.csv.gz` is 448,723,078 bytes with 34 columns and 53,710,760 rows; its parameters include temperature, salinity, oxygen, fluorescence and turbidity, and none is a nutrient.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-FALSIFY: **Falsified if:** R does not move; R moves by materially less than P; or the **total** T moves instead, with no declared change to explain it. Any of the three means the published share is not a share of a partition.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-FETCH: The river-transport series that carry A1's load term — ODA's *Vandløb / Stoftransport / Månedstransport* and *Næringsstoftilførsel til havet* (`ODA-STOFTRANSPORT` and `ODA-TILFOERSEL` in the source register) — are not fetchable by `scripts/fetch_oda.py` as it stands: its `TOPICS` are all under the marine root, and `run()` opens the topic tree at `topic.aspx?id=h&t=h`, that root, so they need a code change, not merely a table entry.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-FIGURES: **SR353's figures.** The 2018 load from land to the coast is about 50,000 t N and point sources about 5,200 t N, computed from 209 coastal stream stations and a model for the unmeasured catchment; the runoff rests on 240 gauging stations in *Vandløb 2018*, against 179 in *Vandløb 2016* and 201 in *Vandløb 2017*; the field surplus ran between 186,000 and 240,000 t N over the latest 5 agrohydrological years.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-HOV: `data/raw/national/hovedoplande.geojson` holds 24 main catchments, among them `DK` *Int vidå-kruså* beside `DK4.1` *Vidå-kruså*: a catchment named as international beside its Danish part.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-INPUT: DCE's DK-QNP model computes the diffuse nitrogen load from the part of the country without measuring stations — *"en model for det resterende umålte opland"* — and the methods chapter of *Vandløb 2018* (`SR353`, Thodsen and colleagues, 2019) names the annually computed field-level nitrogen surplus as an important model variable:
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-KEMI: `data/raw/oda/kemi.csv.gz`, the ODA water-chemistry extract, is held: 1,805,827 rows, with total nitrogen on 190,473, nitrite+nitrate on 182,399 and ammonium on 181,647 — nitrogen **in the sea**, a state and a response, not a load from land.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-NEEDS: A1 predicts that the deficit scales with current-year nitrogen load, and needs catchment nitrogen flux per water body per month; this project holds none — see *Still blocked*.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-NETWORK: So the runoff rests on more stations in each of these reports than in the one before, and a change of vintage can move the total for reasons the report declares — which the test must set aside before it reads its third failure mode.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-NULL: The constraint is **arithmetic identity across two publications**, not sampling: there is no estimator distribution, and n is the number of version changes, which is small. The only noise under the null is publication rounding, computed here rather than quoted.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-P1: Fetch the `Vandløb <year> NOVANA` vintages 2013-2024, one PDF each, streamed to disk, then extracted locally with `pdftotext -layout`; `SR353` and `SR527` are pinned already.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-P2: From each, for every *y* ≥ 1990: total land→coast TN, point sources, diffuse remainder — actual, not normalised.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-P3: Read each vintage's methods chapter for declared changes. SR353 declares a regional bias correction of the modelled load from unmeasured catchments, new that year (*"Bias-korrektionen … er ny i forhold til de foregående år"*); a correction of TN and TP measured in 2016 and the first 4 months of 2017 with a wrong analytical method; a restoration of TN measured by one laboratory in 2007–2014; and a new runoff model for the unmeasured catchments.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-P3-NOTP: Each of these changes the total itself, not a part of it: a declared change of this kind is expected to move T, so it is set aside before the third failure mode is read. The candidates for *P* are changes that count a source apart from the diffuse load, as scattered dwellings are not today.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-P4: For each candidate, form ΔR and ΔT across the vintage boundary and compare them with the 1,100 t bound.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-PARTITION: If a version change moves a part **P** out of the leftover, and the account is a partition, then **R_new(y) = R_old(y) − P** and **T_new(y) = T_old(y)**.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-PRECONDITION: What **can** be tested is a precondition. The agricultural share in circulation, 69.6%, is a residual, and a residual cannot be checked against itself; it can be checked across revisions of the account ([`../RESIDUAL.md`](../RESIDUAL.md)). This page drafts that test against the published reports.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-REJECT: The test takes the worst case. **Reject only when |ΔR + P| > 1,100 t N** — which is also the design's honest limit: **no power against reallocations under 1,100 t N**, beside a point-source term of 5,200 t. More power needs the underlying tables at full precision, not the report text.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-RELATION: The report's sixth chapter then offers, as a result:
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-ROUNDING: SR353 gives the total as *ca.* 50,000 t and the point sources as *ca.* 5,200 t. Read as rounded at their last non-zero digit — units of 1,000 t and 100 t — each lies within half a unit: h = 500 t on the total and h = 50 t on the point sources. Four published quantities enter each comparison (T_old, T_new, P_old, P_new):
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-SD: if the four rounding errors are independent and uniform: a standard deviation of **410 t N**
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-SERIES: `docs/data/areas/stations_series.json` holds 679,422 station-month values summed over its 9 variables (60,460 to 84,668 per variable), from 1,415 stations over 564 months from 1980. Its variables are temperature, salinity, oxygen and oxygen saturation at surface and bed, and fluorescence: **no nutrients**.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-STATUS: The test this page specifies has not been run: no script in this repository reads the published vintages of the national load account or compares them.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-USED: Only the published reports are used by the test. The held monitoring files are what A1 would otherwise be tested on: the station panel and the CTD carry no nitrogen, and the water chemistry carries it as a concentration in the sea.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-VINTAGE-FILES: DCE publish each report as `Vandløb <year>. NOVANA` at `https://dce2.au.dk/pub/SR<n>.pdf`: `SR353` is *Vandløb 2018* and `SR527` *Vandløb 2021*, both pinned here, and the text of each extracts.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-VINTAGES: DCE recompute the series with each report. SR353 runs the national water model over the whole period from 1990 in each reporting year, *"således at den nyeste version af modellen anvendes"*, puts its diffuse nitrogen load 8% lower on average than by the old method, and says the normalised loads of earlier reports are not directly comparable with the new. So a fixed year *y* exists in more than one published vintage, not always with the same value.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-WARNING: And the warning: the water chemistry is nitrogen **concentration in the sea**, a state and a response. Substituting it for a land load would put a response in the place of its driver.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-WOULD: **Would.** 3 or more declared changes with ΔR = −P inside the bound and ΔT inside it license one narrow statement: *the account behaves as a partition under revision.* A single failure of the third kind — T moving with R, with no declared change to explain it — licenses the opposite and stronger one: the share is circular.
hypodrafts/A1.md.C-BA-A1-WOULDNOT: **Would not.** Nothing here licenses a claim about the sea: no mechanism, no nitrogen-load coefficient, no oxygen.

hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-1999: **1999** — the nitrogen norm was cut 10%, lowering the nitrogen *quota* by about 40,000 t N, while grass norms changed and raised it by about 15,000 t N a year; SR120 calls the result a *"spring"* — a step — in the compiled quotas.
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-1999-QUOTA: The quota is what a farm may apply, set from crop norms; it is not a term of the surplus, and a cut in it can change what is applied. Whether the surplus steps at 1999, and by how much, is what the test measures.
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-2012: **2012** — the method for nutrients removed at harvest changed from dry-matter yield to feed units for roughage crops, and SR120 records that its *phosphorus* net-input figures *"er steget lidt ift. de tidligere opgørelser"* — rose against the earlier reports: a revision between vintages, stated for phosphorus. Its effect on nitrogen is not stated there.
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-CLASSES: The surplus is a **norm product**; the load is **hybrid** — measured on the gauged fraction, model output on the rest, since the ungauged part is DK-QNP output whose input is the surplus itself (class `7` in [the taxonomy of data-stream errors](https://github.com/Jjokulian/statistical-methods#7b-rate-a-data-stream-by-the-errors-it-can-contain)). **Use the gauged fraction only**, or the test is partly circular by construction. Measured nitrogen in the sea does not pass through the surplus at all.
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-CONFIRM: **Confirmed if** a regression fitted before 1999 mispredicts after it, in the direction and roughly the magnitude the norm change implies.
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-D-ESTUARY: **Measured nitrogen in the sea**: the held ODA water-chemistry extract carries total nitrogen on 190,473 rows — the independent terminal series.
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-D-GAP: **Surplus and diffuse load per catchment**: no such series has been read here; SR353 gives the national relation, and SR120 balances for its agricultural monitoring catchments, not for the catchments of coastal waters.
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-D-STREAM: **Stream nitrogen where it is gauged**: SR353 computes the national load from 209 coastal stream stations and a model for the rest, so it is measured on the gauged fraction only.
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-D-SURPLUS: **Annual national field surplus, 1990 onward**: SR120's Bilag 1, *Markbalancer for 1990-2013*, in a public report whose text extracts (pinned here).
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-DECLINE: Whether it fell is a separate question, which DCE answer from the measured record: SR353 puts the reduction in nitrogen supply from land to the coast since the start of its series at 51%, calculated on discharge-weighted mean annual concentrations. **Both things can be true: the construction partly administrative, and the decline real.**
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-FALSIFY: **Falsified if** the relation is stable across 1999 — either the norm change passed through to what was applied and to the load, or the step is small relative to the noise; either way the construction carries no spurious discontinuity there.
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-NORMS: `markoverskud`, the field surplus, is built from coefficients as well as counts: manure nitrogen from livestock numbers times the norms in force, crop nitrogen from the editions of the feed tables. It can move when a coefficient moves, with no change in any field. SR120 records two changes on known dates:
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-NULL: A break-point test finds breaks in autocorrelated series with no breaks in them. The null must be **matched-autocorrelation surrogates with no step**, and the reported quantity is where the observed break sits in that distribution — not a p-value against independence.
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-PLACEBO: **Placebo dates.** Fit the same break test at every year 1993–2006. If 1999 is not distinguished from its neighbours, there is no step to find.
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-QUESTION: *The field surplus is a construction; the stream and estuary nitrogen are measured, the stream series only where it is gauged. Do they move together, and does the relation hold still?*
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-REGISTER: This test is not one of the register's hypotheses: it serves A1, and is more specific than it.
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-SIDEWAYS: This is the residual-growth logic applied sideways. There, a part is moved out of a leftover and the arithmetic must close. Here, a part is moved *into* the construction by an administrative decision, and the measurement must **not** move.
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-STATUS: Not run: no script here extracts the surplus series or a load series, and nothing on this page has been computed.
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-STRAT: **Gauged-fraction stratification.** The circular component scales with the modelled share, so the effect should be strongest where a catchment's modelled share is largest and weakest where it is smallest.
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-TEST: **If the constructed series steps at 1999, or at another date where a coefficient changed, and the measured series does not, the surplus↔load relation must break at that date. The size of the break measures the construction's non-physical component.**
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-WHOLE: SR353 states its relation between the national field surplus and the normalised diffuse load *"for perioden som helhed"* — for the period as a whole, over a series it computes from 1990: one relation across the 1999 change. A correlation over the whole period cannot distinguish a real coupling from a coupling plus a shared administrative step; a discontinuity test can, because only one of the two series should step.
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-WOULD: **Would**: a number for how much of the surplus series is administrative, on a stated date, with the measured series as reference.
hypodrafts/A1b.md.C-BA-A1B-WOULDNOT: **Would not**: anything about whether agriculture causes hypoxia. This tests the coherence of two series, one constructed and one measured. A clean break at 1999 would say the construction carries a bookkeeping jump — not that the underlying load did not fall.

hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-A1: **A1 — not settled here.** Its scoping is right: it says its finding *does not show the attribution is wrong*, only that one published figure cannot be what shows it is right — and the chain it examines is the one [what the sea actually receives](../NITROGEN.md) sets out, where DK-QNP takes the field surplus as a key input. Whether it misses independent support for the attribution cannot be judged here: that support would be Windolf and colleagues' paired catchment-and-estuary study, whose text could not be read.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-A1B: **A1b — sound.** It states what a result would and would not license, and it names the field surplus a norm product.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-A7: **A7 — sound.** It downloaded and parsed the flux dataset rather than citing it, and reports none of its stations in the Kattegat, the Belts, the Sound or any Danish fjord: a negative it counted rather than asserted.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-B1: **B1 — needs a stated fix.** The design is strong: exposure enters only as the combined-vs-separate class of the nearest outfall and as an *a-priori* critical rainfall depth, so rainfall cancels in the contrast.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-B1-EEA: **But its central data claim is unverified here.** Its data row counts a table of EEA bathing-water samples that nothing in this repository holds or queries, so every figure in that row, and its `shortTermPollutionSample` count, stands unchecked. **Fix:** mark the EEA row unverified until the table is fetched and counted.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-C1: **C1 — needs a stated fix.** It refuses the published iltsvind extent as a response on the ground that DCE's criterion puts stratification inside the response's definition; DCE define iltsvind by oxygen concentration alone and name stratified water as where it develops, so the extent is not circular by construction. Its choice of raw per-measurement oxygen stands on the design's own unit, the cast. Its null work is sound: it names a non-zero floor, the fully ventilated saturation, rather than assuming zero.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-C4: **C4 — sound.** It checks the Gotland file's units and provenance against the source netCDF, states its permutation floor, and gives its effective event count among what the design would not license.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-C6: **C6 — sound.** It never uses the archived `oxysat_bed` as its outcome, because it is computed from oxygen, temperature and salinity and so shares inputs with the statistic, and uses it once, as a consistency check.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-D1: **D1 — sound.** It breaks the productivity confound with a within-station fixed effect, fluorescence for the confound's time-varying part, and a substrate × effort interaction that the confound does not predict.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-D7: **D7 — sound.** It says the *monthly panel* carries no turbidity while identifying `Turbiditet` in the raw CTD — those are not in conflict — and it models the Secchi censoring that differs between its arms, which this project's light analysis counts.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-E7: **E7 — sound.** It pre-commits to a reclassification test that would make the file wrong.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-F3: **F3 — needs a stated fix.** It avoids the clarity-indicator circularity by using cover rather than depth limit, and states the part it could not remove. That part, the eelgrass light requirement, has no source here, so its adequacy call is only as good as a requirement nobody has pinned.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-G1: **G1 — sound.** It re-derived the station split on a rule it states, set the result beside the split on file, and called the split threshold-dependent. That is the correct handling, and the other drafts that use the split should have done the same.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-I1: **I1 — needs a stated fix.** It opens on the summer-peaked / year-round split carried on file as prior work, without stating the rule behind it or noting that G1 and L3 derived other splits. **Fix:** state the rule inline and cite the brief's stated convention, as one convention among several. Its own methodological work is sound: it dissolves the classification circularity by defining the balanced panel on *presence*, which is observable per era.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-I3: **I3 — needs a stated fix.** It records that there is no time-of-day column anywhere in the archive. That is true of the **CTD extract** and not of ODA as a whole: the water-chemistry extract carries a clock value per sample. **Fix:** scope the claim to the CTD extract.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-J1: **J1 — sound.** It took the new-metric option seriously, wrote the metric down precisely enough to be rejected, then rejected it for reasons it computed rather than by asserting absence.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-K1: **K1 — sound.** Its point that the satellite functional types cannot carry the hypothesis stands on the files' own note that each is derived from chlorophyll. Its claim that OBIS returns cell counts through a measurement extension remains unchecked: no phytoplankton counts are held.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-L3: **L3 — needs a stated fix.** It classifies stations as summer-peaked or year-round on thresholds of the raw Rayleigh resultant length R, and states no minimum number of observations. Under such a rule a station with a single observation has the largest R possible and counts as summer-peaked whenever that observation fell in summer, so the split can measure scarcity rather than season. **Fix:** redo the split under the brief's convention, which classifies on Z = N·R² and calls a station year-round only when it has enough observations, or drop the split arm and rely on the core panel.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-L3-HEAD: **The draft's headline is not touched by this:** it reports its no-trend simulation null on a fixed core panel as well as on the split arms, and the core panel does not use the split.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-R6: **R6 — sound.** It reports that Denmark had a written national method for its own variables and stopped running it, and it states a reclassification test in advance.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-SCOPE: This audit reads each draft in `hypodrafts/` and each open problem in `openproblems/` as committed at `7c4dd30`, and Z8, first committed later, at `0138743`, against the standards in [`../AGENT_BRIEF.md`](../AGENT_BRIEF.md): what kind of thing a quantity is, a null computed rather than quoted, and the steelman rule.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-W1: **Inherited figures are not re-derived, and the one convention that matters was written down in none of them.** G1, I1 and L3 each split the stations into summer-peaked and year-round: G1 on the share of a station's months falling in May–October, L3 on thresholds of the raw resultant length, I1 on the split carried on file. **This is the applefication failure in its purest form: a category everyone uses and nobody defines.** The brief's section on stated conventions fixes one: classify on Z = N·R², and call a station year-round only when it has enough observations for the test to reject.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-W2: **Absence is scoped to the search, not the world — except where it isn't.** D7 gets this right (*the monthly panel carries no turbidity*), I3 gets it wrong (*no time of day* anywhere in the archive). The difference is a clause.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-W2-RULE: Every absence claim in these files should name the *file* it is absent from, never "the archive".
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-W3: **Quantity kinds are named case by case, not by rule.** A1 calls its attribution a residual, A1b calls the field surplus a norm product, B1 calls per-outfall discharge volume a model output and G1 names its estimator; C6 keeps a derived channel out of its outcome and Z8 calls its residual a variance apportionment. The brief asks for the kind beside every quantity.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-W4: **The open problems pre-commit.** E7 and R6 each state in advance the reclassification test that would move them.
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-W5: **Nobody checked anyone else.** The station split is a defect no single draft could show: it appears only when the drafts are read side by side. **This audit is the missing step, and it should run after every batch rather than once.**
hypodrafts/AUDIT.md.C-AF-AU-Z8: **Z8 — sound.** It extracted `TA M06` as a primary document rather than summarising it, and names its residual honestly: *so this yields a variance apportionment, not a budget*.

hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-C1: **`C1` — the class contrast.** At bathing sites whose nearest rain-conditioned outfall is **combined** (`OV/OS/OF/OK/Bypass`), the faecal-indicator response to antecedent rainfall is **steeper** than where the nearest is **separate** stormwater (`SE/SF`), at equal distance, region, month and rainfall.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-C1-FALSIFY: *Falsified if the class × rain interaction is inside the null below, or negative.* B2 alone predicts a rain main effect in **both** arms and a null interaction — so this is the B1/B2 discrimination.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-C2: **`C2` — the storage kink.** A combined structure spills once rain exceeds what it stores. `(vol_sb + vol_fbas)` over `Red areal` gives a **critical rainfall depth in mm** per structure, from engineering attributes that do not move with the weather. B1 predicts a **kink** at that site-specific, *a-priori* depth, with no free breakpoint. *Falsified if the kink amplitude at each site's own threshold sits inside the null from permuting thresholds.*
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-CENSOR: **Left-censoring is not small**: 26,301 of 172,440 E. coli values sit at the limit of detection (15.3%). Fit a censored-normal on log10 counts; a substitution rule invents the effect.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-CLUSTER: The nominal null for 172,440 samples is wrong: sampling is day-clustered. Over the seasons 2011–2024 the table's 130,773 Danish samples fall on 1,425 distinct dates, 92 per date and 102 sampling days a season. Weather is common within a day and correlated across the country, so the independent unit is the **site-day cluster**, and even those dates are not independent draws on weather.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-CONFOUND: **How the shared-rainfall confound breaks.** Rainfall enters both arms of `C1` identically and cancels in the contrast. In `C2` the *location* of the threshold is the signal, and it varies for reasons the weather does not know: runoff, riverine particulate organic carbon, buoyancy, resuspension and bather density are all smooth in rainfall and none carries a basin volume. No modelled overflow volume enters either statistic.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-CSO: **Combined overflows.** `data/raw/spildevand/combined_overflow.geojson` holds 4,217 structures with `Red areal`, an annual volume and `Antal overløb`; `Antal overløb` is empty for 1,676 of them (39.7%), the volume empty for 77 and zero for 719.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-CSO-VOLUME: The annual volume is modelled wherever it is not measured — class `7` there — and is not used here.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-DEPTH: **Derived here: critical rainfall depth.** 1,066 overflows have a name matching exactly one register point, positive storage and positive reduced area; their depth is 0.42 mm at the tenth percentile, 5.2 mm at the median, 32.5 mm at the ninetieth and 2,670 mm at the most.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-DMI: DMI's metObs API serves station precipitation at ten-minute and hourly steps (`precip_past10min`, `precip_past1h`); the source register records test queries answered with no API key, contradicting older documentation, and says to confirm the key policy before building on it.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-FLAGS: **Sample flags** over the same samples: 1,272 `shortTermPollutionSample`, 1,205 `replacementSample`, 22,912 `preSeasonSample`. The table keeps all of them; which of them a compliance assessment may set aside is the Directive's rule, which was not read here.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-HALF: This draft takes a **weaker, falsifiable half**: combined systems deliver *raw sewage* to the shore, event-timed, on a schedule set by their own storage. Two consequences follow, neither using a modelled volume.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-IMPROVE: **Smallest improvement:** the per-structure knowledge level from PULS, or a measured-overflow record such as Vesthimmerlands Forsyning publishes. Either converts a structural proxy into an instrumented subset and moves the exposure out of class `7`.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-JOIN: **The two together.** 3,712 of 4,130 distinct overflow names equal a register `pkt_navn`. The two files disagree on how many structures there are of a type — `OV` 2,812 against 3,015, `OF` 77 against 209 — and both carry type codes that are not among DP02's structure codes: `UR`, `OVI`, `OSI` and `OKI`, and in the register `ikke oplyst`.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-JOIN-CLASS: A code outside DP02's lists is a column holding what its schema does not define: class `4`, not boundable from inside the files.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-LAYER: **Bathing sites.** `data/raw/national/badevand.geojson` holds 1,026 sites with latitude, longitude and a `DKBW…` identifier, and every one of its identifiers is among the Danish identifiers of the EEA table. The table holds more — 1,437 with samples, 1,049 of them never marked delisted — so delisting does not account for all of the difference.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-N1: **`N1` (primary, `C1`): permute the class label** across sites within strata of (distance decile × region × outfall count within 2 km), 10,000 draws — destroys the combined/separate contrast, preserves rainfall, geography, season and site baselines.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-N2: **`N2` (`C1`): circular shift of the daily rainfall field by whole years**, 16 non-zero shifts over the seasons 2008–2024, preserving seasonality, day-clustering and autocorrelation. **The smallest attainable p is one in 17, 0.059 — state it, never exceed it.** Report the more conservative of `N1` and `N2`.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-N3: **`N3` (`C2`): permute the predicted threshold** across structures within a spill-volume stratum: keeps the kink, destroys the link to a site's own storage.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-NEAREST: **Derived here: the nearest outfall.** Of the 1,026 bathing sites, 284 have a combined structure nearest and 742 a separate outlet; the median distance is 0.87 km, 541 lie within a kilometre (`within_1km`) and 741 within two (`within_2km`).
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-NONATIONAL: No national series of measured overflow is held or was found here: the public extract carries each structure's reported annual volume and number of overflows, and how many of those volumes were measured is not known.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-NOT-LOAD: (b) No load, no volume, no attribution — there is no denominator, so any *share of* is out of reach by construction.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-NOT-OXYGEN: (a) **Nothing about oxygen.** This is B1's delivery limb, bearing on O9, not on O1: faecal indicators are not COD, so the oxygen claim stays unscored — and they are not the rotting algae that fedtemøg names, so O2 stays unscored too.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-NOT-SELECTED: (d) Sampling may be **selected against the exposure** — if visits avoid storms, and since the table flags replacement samples beside short-term-pollution ones — which would attenuate the effect toward zero, so a positive result survives it but a null does **not** license *no effect*.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-NOT-TWO: (e) E. coli and enterococci are two counts from one sample and one visit: one piece of evidence, not two.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-NOT-WINDOW: (c) The window is **bathing season only**, set by human use and so circular, as [NITROGEN.md](../NITROGEN.md) argues.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-P1: Stream the Danish subset of `timeseries_MonitoringResult` and `timeseries_SeasonalPeriod` from DISCODATA; join to `badevand.geojson` on its `DKBW…` identifiers.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-P2: Per site: nearest combined and nearest separate register point, and counts within 500 m, 1 km and 2 km. Keep the geometry; aggregate nothing.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-P3: Rainfall: confirm DMI's key policy, then antecedent depth over 6, 12, 24 and 48 h before each sample at the nearest gauge. Until then the design is stated, not run.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-P4: **`C1`:** censored regression of log10 E. coli on rain × class, with site fixed effects, month, distance and year. Report the interaction. Repeat on enterococci — a second organism, not a second dataset.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-P5: **`C2`:** for the 1,066 threshold-bearing structures and their nearest sites, test the jump at each site's own predicted depth, standardised and summed across sites.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-P6: **Anchor:** samples inside a declared `shortTermPollution` period against matched samples at the same site and month outside one — the arm that uses no rain model at all.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-PERIODS: **The dated episode log**, `timeseries_SeasonalPeriod`, holds for Danish sites 1,208 `shortTermPollution` periods (2011–2024), 755 `bathingProhibition` (from 2017), 76 `abnormalSituation` and 76 `cyanobacteriaBloom` periods.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-POSITIONS: **Sites are positions, not replicates**, never aggregated into water bodies: the unit is outfall-to-site distance, which is what the mechanism has.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-RAIN: **Rainfall is the gap.** No rain-gauge series is held. The rain record held, under `data/raw/weather`, is hourly ERA5 reanalysis over Copenhagen from Open-Meteo, and the Baltic winds under `data/raw/marine` are ERA5 too; a reanalysis in place of gauges would be class `7`.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-RBU: **The national register** `data/raw/national/punkt_rbu_udl.geojson` holds 19,665 rain-conditioned outfall points: `vol_sb` is filled on 4,068 (2,740 of them zero), `vol_fbas` on 8,763 (5,771 zero).
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-SEWAGE: Overflow water carries sewage and separate stormwater is meant to carry none, so a faecal indicator should rise more with rain where the nearest outfall is combined — though runoff can bring animal faeces into both arms.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-SRC-DP02: **DP02** states the uncertainty of a reported volume by knowledge level, from 135% for a simple mass balance to 30% for measurement-based estimation: the citation for class `7`, not data.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-SRC-KBH: **Copenhagen's bathing-water forecast** — whether it keeps a public archive of measured overflow is not established: its host `kbh.badevand.dk` did not resolve from here.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-SRC-PULS: **PULS**, where every rain-dependent discharge is reported with its volume graded by how it was found, would name an instrumented subset; access goes through an organisation's IT coordinator, and this project reads only the public extract.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-SRC-UWWTD: **Waterbase-UWWTD** reports discharge points and agglomerations of the urban waste-water directive per reporting cycle; the source register lists it for B3 and A4, not for overflow.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-SRC-VHF: **Vesthimmerlands Forsyning** (`/spildevand/overloebsdata`) publishes, for the 11 registered overflow points on its combined systems, monthly counts and volumes of overflow for 2025 with an archive of earlier years; the points carry sensors that measure overflow, and some discharge to the Limfjord.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-SRC-VHF-LEVEL: So a measured set, but a small one — and whether its volumes meet DP02's measurement-based level, whose examples add measured substance to measured flow, the page does not say.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-SRC-VP3: **MiljøGIS `vp3basis2019`**: the national VP3 web feature service answered an anonymous capabilities request when this project probed it.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-SRC-WISE: **WISE bathing water** (above) — **a separate path**: counts per dated sample and the periods authorities report, with no hydraulic model in the chain.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-STATUS: The test this page specifies has not been run: no script in this repository fetches the bathing-water samples, joins a rain series to them, or computes either consequence.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-TAIL: A basin that stores 2,670 mm of rain over its reduced area is implausible, so the tail is taken as a unit error and trimmed above the `p95`.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-TAXONOMY: Error classes are those of [a taxonomy that rates a data stream by the errors it can contain](https://github.com/Jjokulian/statistical-methods#7b-rate-a-data-stream-by-the-errors-it-can-contain): `2` is quantisation, among it censoring at a threshold; `4` schema conflation, one column pooling incommensurables; `6` an absent dimension, no column at all; `7` model-as-datum, a modelled value in a column shaped like a measured one.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-TYPETAL: The typetal in DP02 put total nitrogen at 12 mg/l in overflow water and 43 mg/l in sewage, against 2 mg/l at a separate system's stormwater outlet.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-VOLUME: B1 is to be discriminated *against per-outfall discharge volume*. That volume is reported to PULS at one of the knowledge levels Miljøstyrelsen's DP02 sets, from a PULS calculation to measurement-based estimation, and how many structures report a measured volume is not known here; below the measured level it is a model output driven by rainfall, which drives every rival too, so regressing a rainfall-driven response on it tests rainfall.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-WISE: **Bathing-water samples.** The EEA's WISE table `timeseries_MonitoringResult`, queried through `discodata.eea.europa.eu/sql`, holds 172,440 Danish samples, each dated and each with an E. coli and an enterococci count, under 1,437 site identifiers over the seasons 2008–2024: 10,144 a season on average. No count is empty. E. coli is flagged at the limit of detection on 26,301 samples and as a missing value on 688 that still carry a number (enterococci: 31,478 and 723). A record has a sample date and no time of day.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-WISE-CLASS: The detection-limit flag is censoring, class `2`: boundable, not recoverable. The missing time of day is class `6`, an absent dimension, which no processing can restore.
hypodrafts/B1.md.C-BA-B1-WOULD: **Would.** That combined systems deliver sewage-borne contamination to the shore, event-timed, near their outfalls, across 17 seasons and 1,026 sites — and via `C2` that the timing is set by storage, not weather alone. It separates B1 from B2 on a signature rather than a shared driver.

hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-A: **C1a (gradient).** Within one station and calendar month, casts with stronger density structure have less oxygen in the bottom metre.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-B: **C1b (floor).** Well-mixed casts do not show low bottom oxygen — the strong claim, and the falsifiable one.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-CIRC1: `oxysat_*` is ODA's oxygen saturation, which the national CTD method computes with temperature and salinity — two of the three inputs shared with φ. **Not used.** Only `Oxygen indhold` in mg/l.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-CIRC2: Salinity is computed from conductivity and temperature, so φ rests on two sensor channels and oxygen on a third. Not circular — but φ's error and T_bed's error are correlated wherever T_bed is a covariate.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-CIRC3: **The residual coupling is thermodynamic, and is the whole difficulty.** Oxygen *solubility* falls as temperature rises and depends on salinity: a warm stratified summer has high φ and low saturation concentration for reasons that are C6, not C1. Not removable by a covariate; measured instead, in §3.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-COUNTS: One streaming pass over the whole extract, by `scripts/hypodraft_ctd.py`, counts 152,671 station-days — one station on one date — with both a `Temperatur` and a `Salinitet` value; 143,629 of them with at least 4 depth levels of each; 133,509 of those also with an `Oxygen indhold` value in mg/l; 94,243 of those joined to a recorded `BundDybde_m` in `maaledybde.csv.gz`, and 49,272 of these with a temperature profile reaching 10 m. Of all 152,671, 139,663 have their deepest O₂ within 1.5 m of the deepest temperature or below it. They come from 1,478 stations, 1970 to 2026.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-DEF: DCE call it iltsvind when the oxygen concentration in the water is below 4 mg/l, and name stratified water as where it develops, not as part of the definition.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-DEPTHRES: φ depends on how finely a cast is resolved in depth: the test recomputes φ on the finest casts against decimated copies of themselves and reports the difference as a bound.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-DIURNAL: A midday cast can carry a warm surface layer a dawn cast does not, inflating φ with no ventilation meaning: this attenuates C1a (making it conservative) and inflates the mixed set for C1b (making it anti-conservative). The CTD extract alone can neither count nor correct it; where water chemistry was sampled on the same station-day and its clock is a real time rather than a filled-in default, that clock can bound the hour.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-FALS: **A falsification of C1b** — hypoxic casts in well-mixed columns — is the strongest thing available here, and it is one-directional. Finding them refutes "near zero in well-mixed water whatever the load." *Not* finding them confirms nothing: where well-mixed casts are taken may keep them oxygenated for other reasons, and without a clock some casts labelled mixed may have been sampled at dawn.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-FALSA: **Falsifies C1a:** the association between the potential energy anomaly φ and bottom oxygen does not exceed the computed nulls of §3.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-FALSB: **Falsifies C1b:** more casts with stratification in the lowest quintile *and* low bottom oxygen than Null C allows. Then a mixed column can also run out, and "near zero in well-mixed water" is false as stated.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-LIC: **A positive C1a result licenses:** within a station and month, stronger density structure accompanies lower bottom oxygen by more than shared thermodynamics explains. **It does not license** causation — wind (C2), bottom temperature (C6), residence time (C3) and load all covary with φ — nor anything about persistence, nor weighting a nitrogen coefficient by stratification: load is not in the CTD extract, and ODA's topic of nutrient input to the sea is not fetched.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-NOCLOCK: The CTD extract has no time of day, and no column for it; the water-chemistry extract does carry a clock value per sample.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-NOSERIES: `stations_series.bin` cannot be used: it is a monthly *median* of surface and bed separately, which breaks the pairing a cast needs.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-NULLA: **Null A — the thermodynamic surrogate.** Replace each cast's observed C_bed with C_sat(T_bed, S_bed): what a fully ventilated, non-respiring column would hold. Recompute ρ. This is the association φ has with bottom oxygen under **no ventilation limitation at all**, arising purely from shared T and S — **the floor the observed ρ must beat.** Bootstrap over stations, 1,000 draws.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-NULLB: **Null B — the design null.** Strata = station × calendar month × decile of recorded bottom depth. Shuffle φ within strata, recompute the *pooled* ρ, 1,000 times. The result is not centred on zero: it retains the between-stratum association depth, season and place produce on their own. Its distance from zero is the size of the confounding — a result worth reporting by itself.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-NULLC: **Null C — for C1b.** Let *p* = the fraction of casts in the lowest φ quintile (within depth decile) whose C_bed falls below the 5th percentile of C_bed in its own station × calendar-month stratum. C1b predicts *p* near zero. Null C is *p* under the same stratified shuffle as Null B — near 0.05, but **not assumed to be 0.05**: the two stratifications interact. Report the permutation distribution.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-P1: Stream `ctd.csv.gz` once, emitting `(station, date, depth, parameter, value)` for the three parameters, with intermediates on disk; never load the archive into memory.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-P2: Keep casts with at least 4 paired T/S levels, a bottom O₂ within 1.5 m of the deepest T, and a `BundDybde_m` join. Never aggregate into water bodies — station and position are the units.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-P3: Potential density per level, under **both** `EOS-80` and `TEOS-10`, reporting the difference as a bound rather than picking one; then φ = (g/h)∫(ρ̄ − ρ(z))·z dz over the cast.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-P4: C_sat(T_bed, S_bed) for Null A. Compute the statistic and all three nulls. Report ρ **beside** Null A and Null B, never beside zero.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-P5: Report the count and station list of lowest-quintile-φ casts with C_bed below 4 mg/l — DCE's iltsvind threshold, borrowed and flagged as such — plus the full distribution.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-PHI: φ is computed from density, and density from temperature and salinity.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-PRED: C1 predicts that deficit "tracks the strength and persistence of the pycnocline, and is near zero in well-mixed water whatever the load."
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-PRIMARY: **Primary sample: the 94,243 station-days with levels, oxygen and a recorded bottom depth.**
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-PROBE: `SondeNavn` begins with the unknown-probe code `999` on 31.8% of the `Temperatur` rows (2,384,882 of 7,501,421), 31.7% of the `Salinitet` rows (2,365,982 of 7,474,645), 29.8% of the `Oxygen indhold` rows (2,130,873 of 7,147,012); on those rows the instrument is not recorded.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-RAW: The test uses raw per-measurement oxygen, not the published iltsvind extent: it compares casts within a station and month, and an extent mapped per survey carries neither the cast nor its density profile.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-SALNOVA: The same method sends salinity and temperature measured on a water sample to the water-chemistry record, with the sampler given as a water bottle, not as CTD.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-SCOPE: *Persistence* is not testable here. A cast is a snapshot, the extract holds visits rather than a continuous record, and whether a pycnocline held between visits is unobserved. What follows tests **strength only**; persistence needs a moored temperature and salinity chain for a stratified season — an instrument, not an analysis.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-SHARE: **Nothing here licenses a share.** φ explaining variance in C_bed is a within-field statement about one of 166 enumerated mechanisms, not a decomposition.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-SRC: **Source:** `data/raw/oda/ctd.csv.gz` (448.7 MB gzipped), one row per measurement, with `Dybde (m)` and coordinates.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-STAT: Statistic: **Spearman ρ between φ and bottom oxygen C_bed**, pooled over eligible casts, set against the nulls below, because zero is not the null under the constraints imposed here.
hypodrafts/C1.md.C-AF-C1-STATUS: The test this page specifies has not been run: no script in this repository computes it.

hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-BEDBIN: Each value is a station's monthly median, and `_bed` is the deepest quarter of each cast's depth range, so *near the bed* is a band whose depth changes from cast to cast; the extract behind it has no time of day.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-BOUND: `N1` and `N2` bound the answer from two sides; take the more conservative.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-CHAIN: So the Gotland file is observation-derived and the Arkona and Bornholm file is not: the observations run from the Danish stations to the Gotland Deep, and `sob_ark` and `sob_bor` serve only as a model check.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-FALSIFY: **Falsified if** the peak lags are not in path order, or the Gotland salinity peak comes no later than the event month, or the ordering statistic — Kendall τ of peak lag against the sites' order along the path — lies inside the null below.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-FILL: Both netCDF files mark a missing cell with the fill value `1e36` (`_FillValue`); a reader that does not mask it averages fill into the result.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-FLAGS: The panel holds values no water can hold — the flag record marks the sign-inverted oxygen of May and June 2005 — so it is read with the flag record beside it.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-GOTFILE: `…_mbi_sto2tz_gotland_P20250527.nc` holds `so`, `to` and `oxy` against depth at the Gotland Deep, on a monthly step and a one-metre depth step; its title ends *from Observations Reprocessing*, and its comment says the measurements were regridded onto that grid, so fine vertical structure is interpolation between discrete samples. Salinity and temperature run from 1993-01 to 2024-11; oxygen, declared as a volume fraction in units of `0.001` (ml/l), fills 226 months from 2005-11 to 2025-01.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-GOTUNITS: `docs/data/baltic/gotland.json`, the project's copy of the Gotland profiles, converts the oxygen from ml/l to mg/l and records the product as in-situ profiles regridded onto a grid, not a reanalysis.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-INDEX: Eastward wind at the southern point (`wind_baltic_s.json`), from speed and direction, as a daily mean; its 10-day running sum is the westerly burst, multiplied by the easterly deficit of the 35 days before it, with a gap of 5 days between them, as preconditioning. Winter maxima of the index give the event onsets.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-INDEX-NORUN: No script here computes the index, so which winters it ranks highest is not known, and whether its maxima are the published inflow events can be checked only against the IOW record, which is not held.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-IOW: **The published inflow record is not held.** IOW's Major Baltic Inflow statistics (Mohrholz) are registered as an open download — a daily barotropic transport series with a list of dated events — for A5, C1 and C4, and the register calls them the published inflow record C4 needs.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-MAAL: `data/raw/oda/maaledybde.csv.gz` gives `BundDybde_m` per visit: 151,203 records, with a bottom depth at 1,176 stations.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-MBIFILE: `data/raw/cmems/indicators/omi_health_tempsaloxy_baltic_mbi_bottom_salinity_arkona_bornholm_P20250527.nc` holds `sob_ark` and `sob_bor`, daily from 1993-01-01 to 2024-12-31 with no value missing. Its title reads *bottom salinity from Reanalysis* and its source is `BALTICSEA_MULTIYEAR_PHY_003_011`: **a model output, not an observation**.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-N1: **`N1`, primary: circular shift of the event index by whole years**, over the years from 1995, when the wind begins, that the index and the responses share. Whole years keep event seasonality, any seasonal pattern of sampling and every series' autocorrelation; only the alignment dies. The smallest p it can give is one over the number of alignments, the true one included — state it, never exceed it.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-N2: **`N2`: 10,000 amplitude-adjusted phase-randomised surrogates** of each response.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-NEXT: **Smallest improvement:** fetch the IOW Major Baltic Inflow statistics, replacing a self-built proxy with the published chronology C4 names.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-NOT-EXO: (c) It does not test *entirely exogenous to Danish policy*: exogeneity of the wind is assumed, and exogeneity of the consequences is a different claim.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-NOT-N: (a) The effective sample is the number of inflow events, not the number of months, so no effect size is estimable; and the Gotland oxygen record begins in 2005-11, so the oxygen limb sees only the events after that — how many, the published chronology would say.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-NOT-O1: (b) Nothing about C4's contribution to **O1** in Danish water: the design follows salinity along the path toward the Gotland Deep and has no step from there to oxygen at Danish stations.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-NOT-THREE: (d) `sal_bed`, `temp_bed` and `oxysat_bed` come from the same CTD casts; salinity is estimated from conductivity, and saturation is oxygen as a share of what water holds at its temperature and salinity: they are **one** piece of evidence, not three.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-NULLRULE: Not the statistic's nominal null. Deep water in the central Baltic is renewed by major inflows and otherwise stagnates, so a Gotland deep series persists from one month to the next, and a threshold set for independent months is crossed more often than it allows. The null is computed on surrogates that keep the series' own persistence.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-ORDER: The falsifiable half of C4 is **ordered propagation**: a wind-forced inflow event at month τ produces a bottom-salinity anomaly whose **peak lag increases along the path** Belts/Øresund → Arkona → Bornholm → Gotland Deep, read there at 200 m, the depth at which the published inflow statistics read the eastern Gotland Basin. The test is whether the peaks fall in that order.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-P1: Build the wind index above; take its winter maxima and the top *k* onsets, for k = 3, 5 and 8, declared before seeing the answer.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-P2: Per station, subtract that station's **own** month-of-year median from `sal_bed`, `sal_surf` and `oxy_bed`; divide by its interquartile range. Never pool before de-seasoning.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-P3: Same for `sob_ark` and `sob_bor` as monthly means, and for the Gotland `so` and `oxy` at 200 m, after masking the fill value, in the file's own units.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-P4: Superposed-epoch composite at lags from −12 to +24 months per site; record the peak lag.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-P5: Statistic: Kendall τ of peak lag against the sites' order along the path — Belts, Arkona, Bornholm, Gotland. τ depends only on ranks, so the order gives the same statistic as any distances that keep it.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-P7: Secondary: the same on `sal_bed − sal_surf`; and a check on `oxy_bed` for a rise followed by a fall — the pulse ventilating, then stratifying.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-PANEL: **The rule.** Stations inside 10–15 °E and 54–56.5 °N whose median bottom depth is at least 20 m and which carry at least 120 monthly `sal_bed` medians in 1993–2024, each listed individually, never merged into a water body.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-PANEL-N: No script here applies the rule, so how many stations pass it, and in which months they were sampled, is not known.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-PANELNULL: **The panel's stations are not replicates.** Neighbouring positions sampled in the same months can see the same water, so the statistic is the median across positions of a per-station z-anomaly, the panel shifts as one, and the null is over **time only**: spread across stations buys precision, not degrees of freedom. The sensitivity run is one fit per station, reported as a *distribution of lags*, not as separate tests. If only the composite shows the signal, the composite made it.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-RP: Random phases keep a series' periodogram, its linear correlation; the amplitude-adjusted version (AAFT) tries to keep its distribution of values as well.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-SECONDARY: Secondary: an event should raise `sal_bed` more than `sal_surf`. If both rise alike, the salinity difference between bed and surface at the Danish stations does not grow, and the part of C4 that has the pulses strengthen stratification above them is not seen at the Danish end.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-SERIES: `docs/data/areas/stations_series.{json,bin}`, the monthly panel: `sal_bed` on 83,309 station-months at 1,395 stations, `oxy_bed` on 76,980 at 1,327, `sal_surf` on 83,341; the `.bin` is exactly as long as the layout its `.json` declares.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-STATUS: The test this page specifies has not been run: no script in this repository computes it.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-WIND: `data/raw/marine/wind_baltic_n.json`, `_c` and `_s` each hold hourly `wind_speed_10m` (km/h) and `wind_direction_10m` from 1995-01-01T00:00 to 2025-12-31T23:00 with no value missing, each at one point; all three points lie east of Bornholm, so none is over the Kattegat or the Belts.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-WINDSRC: No script in this repository fetched them and `data/raw/` is not under version control, so what model or observation lies behind this wind is not recorded here.
hypodrafts/C4.md.C-CC-C4-WOULD: **Would.** A clean falsification if the order breaks — cheap, and robust to any error that shifts or rescales a series without moving when its peak falls, because τ uses only the order of the peak lags. Otherwise weak corroboration, capped at `N1`'s p floor.

hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-AGG: **Aggregation.** These are monthly *medians*, `_bed` is the deepest quarter of each cast's depth range, and each variable's median is taken separately, so the T, S and O medians of one station-month need not come from the same cast.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-CEILING: Oxygen solubility is a function of temperature and salinity (and of pressure), computed from published equations; Weiss (1970) proposed the set this draft uses. That half of C6 needs no test.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-DEF: `D = C_sat(T_bed, S_bed) − O_bed` (mg/l), with `C_sat` from Weiss's equations in ml/l, converted at 1.42905 mg per ml.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-DELIBERATE: `D` contains T through `C_sat` deliberately — that is the *removal* of the solubility channel, not circularity, because `C_sat` is a fixed published function, not fitted to these data.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-EIV: The residual risk is errors-in-variables: an error ε in T enters `D` through `C_sat`, which falls as temperature rises, and enters the regressor unchanged, so it pulls β̂ toward a **negative** value as well as toward none. The test is therefore conservative in the direction that matters. Salinity, derived from conductivity and temperature, carries temperature error too; the size of either effect has not been computed here.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-FALSIFY: **What would falsify it:** *within a fixed station and a fixed calendar month, across years, `D` does not rise with that year's near-bed temperature* — a pooled within-cell slope β̂ that is not positive, or one the permutation null below cannot tell from none. That falsifies C6's non-thermodynamic content at the resolution this archive has.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-FLAGS: **Impossible values.** The panel holds values no water can hold — the flag record marks the sign-inverted oxygen of May and June 2005 — so the plausibility filter comes before anything else.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-HOUR: Within a station and calendar month, where the test works, the season's pull on the hour of sampling is held fixed; what remains is any change in that hour from year to year, which the detrending absorbs only where it is a trend. It is not correctable from this archive, and it caps what any result licenses.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-JOIN-NORUN: No script here joins the three near-bed arrays, so how many station-months carry all three, how many pass the plausibility filter, and how many cells have enough years are not known.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-NEUTRAL: `D` is solubility-neutral by construction: if temperature acted on near-bed oxygen *only* through the ceiling, `D` would not depend on `T`.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-NOCLOCK: **No time of day.** The raw header (`data/raw/oda/ctd.csv.gz`, 34 columns) has `Dato` as `19701013` — a date, no hour — and no other time field.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-NOQ10: It cannot calibrate Q10 at all: converting a respiration *rate* to a standing deficit needs a ventilation timescale this archive does not record.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-NOTOUTCOME: The archive's `oxysat_bed` is **never the outcome here**: saturation is oxygen as a share of what the water can hold at its temperature, so regressing it on temperature would put temperature on both sides.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-NOTRESP: **Would not.** It does not identify respiration: DCE name wind mixing as slowing oxygen depletion and high temperature as promoting it, and a warm year can also be a calm one, so a larger deficit may be failed ventilation rather than Q10.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-NOWB: **The unit is a station, never a water body.**
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-NOWBODY: It says nothing about water bodies.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-NULLRES: And a slope indistinguishable from none would **not** refute C6 in nature; it would refute it at the resolution of monthly medians taken at an unrecorded hour.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-P1: Read the three near-bed arrays at the offsets in the `.json`; key on `station_index × 1000 + month_index`; keep 0 ≤ O ≤ 20 mg/l, −2 ≤ T ≤ 30 °C and 0 ≤ S ≤ 40, and report what the filter removes.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-P2: Compute `C_sat` and `D`. Keep cells with at least 8 distinct years.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-P3: Centre T and D on their cell means. Estimate β̂ = Σ(t̃·d̃)/Σ(t̃²) — the station × calendar-month fixed-effects slope of deficit on temperature, mg/l per °C.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-P4: **Null, computed under the constraint actually imposed.** 2,000 permutations: within each cell independently, permute D across years with T held in place. This keeps cell means, the seasonal cycle, every station effect and both marginals, destroying only the within-cell T–D pairing. Two-sided p = fraction with |β*| ≥ |β̂|. Report the permutation SD *and* the OLS SE and their ratio: near-bed deficits at neighbouring stations in the same month can be the same water mass sampled twice, so the textbook SE assumes an independence the data need not have. That ratio is the size of the error a quoted null would have made.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-P5: Repeat with D linearly detrended on year within each cell, so that a trend temperature and deficit share across the years cannot manufacture β̂. Report both, and the variants with at least 3 and at least 10 years.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-P6: Subsidiary: per station, the flag rate under `O < 4` and under a deficit threshold set so that it flags the same share of station-months; Spearman ρ over the stations; count the stations flagged by one and not the other. Null: permute calendar-month labels within station.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-P7: Confirmatory version, if step 4 clears: rebuild `D` from the temperature, salinity and oxygen of the *same cast* by streaming the CTD extract, removing the pairing gap that monthly medians leave.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-QUANT: **Quantisation.** Raw `Temperatur` is written with at most one decimal on 1,076,874 of 7,501,421 rows of the whole CTD extract (14%); how much that rounding moves `C_sat` has not been computed here.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-RESIDUE: The testable residue is the Q10 half: **at constant organic supply, does warmer bottom water sit further below its own ceiling?**
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-SATSRC: How ODA computes the saturation it supplies — `Oxygenmætning`, a parameter of its own in the CTD extract — is not documented in anything held or pinned here, so whether it rests on the same equations as `C_sat` is not known.
