hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-SERIES: `docs/data/areas/stations_series.{json,bin}` holds 679,422 station-months — the sum over its 9 variables — at 1,415 stations, in 564 monthly slots from January 1980. Near-bed: `oxy_bed` 76,980 · `temp_bed` 84,656 · `sal_bed` 83,309 · `oxysat_bed` 64,493.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-STATUS: The test this page specifies has not been run: no script in this repository computes it. The counts it prints are read from held outputs.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-SUBSID: **Subsidiary, about the iltsvind threshold:** *the `< 4 mg/l` flag ranks stations by consumption, not by ceiling height.* Falsified if station-level flag rates under `O < 4` and under a deficit flag with the same overall rate rank stations differently.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-UNFILLED: **Unfilled.** At least 12,487 `oxy_bed` station-months carry no saturation — the difference of the two counts, a lower bound — and `SondeNr` is `999`, probe unknown, on 25.6% of the CTD extract.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-USGS: The U.S. Geological Survey has replaced Weiss's equations with those of Benson and Krause for its own oxygen work.
hypodrafts/C6.md.C-CC-C6-WOULD: **Would.** A positive β̂ surviving the permutation null and the detrending licenses: near-bed temperature moves near-bed oxygen beyond solubility, within station and within calendar month, in this archive — the gap C6 names, since the standing statistical models carry surface temperature only.

hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-BOUNDARY: Carry distance to a class boundary as a covariate, and test stations near a boundary separately.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-CLUSTER: Stations that share a c-square share its effort, so effort is a shared regressor and errors must cluster on the c-square.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-CONFOUND: The obvious confound: trawlers fish where fish are, and fish are where productivity is, so any raw effort–oxygen association is that association read backwards. The within-station fixed effect, fluorescence and the substrate interaction break it, and only together: the fixed effect removes everything time-invariant about a place (depth, substrate, mean productivity, distance from a source); fluorescence absorbs the time-varying part of the same confound; and the substrate interaction is a prediction the confound does not make, since productivity-driven effort would depress oxygen wherever trawlers work, while resuspension can only do it where reduced fines exist.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-FALSIFY: **Falsified if:** the within-station coefficient lies inside the null distribution below; **or** the coarse-substrate coefficient is indistinguishable from the mud one; **or** the surface placebo moves with effort as strongly as the bed. The substrate interaction and the surface placebo are what make this a test of trawling rather than of where fish are.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-FLEET: Vessels without VMS are not in the layers, and which vessels carried it in these years is not established from any document pinned here, so how much of the inshore fleet is missing is unknown.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-FLUO: Fluorescence (`fluo`), the productivity covariate, fills 60,460 station-months. It is a sensor channel of the CTD cast, not the laboratory chlorophyll the water-chemistry extract carries separately as `Klorofyl a`, on 185,314 rows.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-LICENSE: A mud-confined, bed-only coefficient outside both nulls would license exactly this: *trawling effort in the preceding quarter is associated with lower near-bed oxygen at Danish stations, 2016–2021, on fine substrate, beyond a null preserving the spatial and temporal structure of effort.* Not a budget attribution; not a causal claim (effort is not randomised, and a quarterly total cannot separate the trawl pass from what followed it); nothing about the fauna outcomes O3 and O7, since no fauna variable is here; nothing about vessels VMS does not see.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-MECH: Read as an oxygen mechanism rather than a fauna one, D1 says gear dragged over fine reduced sediment resuspends sulphide and labile organic matter, which consume oxygen where they are released: at the bed, within weeks, **and only where fine reduced sediment exists.** Per station-quarter:
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-META: **The effort layers.** HELCOM's metadata record for them says they are based on VMS data, processed by ICES's working group on spatial fisheries data (WGSFD) to c-square products, by year and by quarter; for the mobile bottom-contacting gear groups — dredge, demersal seine and otter trawl, and their total — they give swept area and the surface and subsurface swept-area ratio (`sur_sar`, `subsur_sar` in the shapefiles), and these, unlike weight, value and fishing hours, are never withheld for anonymity.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-NULL-SPATIAL: **Spatial arm** (cross-sectional, the weak one). Constraint: stations sit where they sit and effort has the structure it has. Null: keep the effort field whole and break only its *registration* with the stations — random rotations and toroidal translations within a Danish sea mask, rejecting draws that put more than 5% of stations on no-data; plus a second null by `contiguous_null`-style connected block resampling on the c-square adjacency graph with matched block sizes. At least 999 draws, reported against both.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-NULL-WITHIN: **Within-station arm** (primary). Constraint: station identity, month-of-year and year are absorbed. Null: circular shifts of each station's own effort series by whole years, plus a cluster bootstrap over stations. This preserves each station's effort marginal, the seasonal cycle and effort's serial correlation, breaking only the time alignment.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-NULLWHY: The test has a spatial arm and a within-station arm, each with its own constraint and null, and **neither null is a plain shuffle.** Effort is spatially autocorrelated and so is bathymetry, and contiguity alone makes partitions agree: on this project's nearest-neighbour graph of 150 stations, random connected partitions with group sizes matched to the official water bodies agree with each other at a mean adjusted Rand index of 0.337 (`docs/data/areas/partition_contiguous.json`, `contiguous_null` in `scripts/partition_contiguous.py`), where the index corrects for chance against arbitrary partitions, not contiguous ones. A cell-wise shuffle of effort would repeat that mistake.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-OVERLAP: How many of the panel's station-months fall in the effort layers' years, at how many stations and in how many c-squares, is not counted by any script here: the overlap is the first thing the test must count.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-P-PLACEBO: **Placebo.** No comparable effect in near-**surface** oxygen at the same stations.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-P-SUB: **Substrate interaction.** The effect is present on *Mud and sandy mud* / *Muddy sand* / *Quaternary clay and silt* and absent on *Sand* / *Gravel and coarse sand* / *Till/diamicton* / *Sedimentary rock*.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-P-WITHIN: **Within station.** Near-bed oxygen anomaly is lower in a station's own quarters following a high subsurface swept-area ratio (`subsur_sar`) in its c-square than in its own quarters following a low one, after removing station mean, month-of-year and year.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-PANEL: **The panel.** `docs/data/areas/stations_series.json`, the monthly panel this project analyses, holds 679,422 station-months across its 9 variables at 1,415 stations, over 564 months from 1980: one median per station, month and variable, so a station-quarter built from it is a median of medians. Near-bed oxygen (`oxy_bed`) fills 76,980 station-months and near-surface oxygen (`oxy_surf`), the placebo, 76,963.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-POSGAP: How often a measurement's position differs from its station's is not counted here.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-POSITION: **Depth and position.** The CTD extract, `data/raw/oda/ctd.csv.gz` (448.7 MB compressed), has columns beside each station's coordinates (`X_UTM32`, `Y_UTM32`) for the depth (`Dybde (m)`) and the position (`MålingX_UTM32`, `MalingY_UTM32`) of each measurement row, so one streamed pass can place each cast in the c-square it was taken in, with its depth.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-QUARTER: The layers are totals per c-square, gear group and quarter, so timing within a quarter is gone and the test's lag can only be a whole quarter.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-S1: Fetch and unzip the archive named above; keep the mobile bottom-contacting gear groups the record lists; count the c-squares that intersect the stations' bounding box.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-S2: Assign each cast to its own c-square from its measurement coordinates; roll to station-quarter medians of the variables used below.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-S3: Join `subsur_sar` of the *preceding* quarter; keep fluorescence same-quarter, not lagged.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-S4: Fit near-bed oxygen on the lagged `log1p(subsur_sar)` with station, month and year fixed effects and covariates: fluorescence, near-bed temperature (solubility), near-bed salinity (stratification proxy), depth.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-S5: Refit with a substrate × effort interaction; repeat the whole fit on surface oxygen as the placebo.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-S6: Report every coefficient against both nulls above, never a textbook p-value.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-SARMODEL: Swept-area ratio is computed, not observed; how fishing is told from steaming and how each gear's width is set is not described in either record pinned here.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-SCALE: The layer is compiled from surveys at map scales whose denominators, in the `scale` field, run from 5,000 to 500,000, with 7 polygons at the finest scale and 7 at the coarsest, so boundary precision is not uniform.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-SEABED: **Substrate.** `data/raw/geus/seabed_sediment_dk.gpkg`, layer `Seabed_sedimen`, holds 108 polygons in 7 classes of the field `sedimenten`: Sand 22, Till/diamicton 22, Gravel and coarse sand 22, Muddy sand 16, Quaternary clay and silt 14, Mud and sandy mud 9, Sedimentary rock 3 — counts of polygons, not of area.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-STATUS: The test this page specifies has not been run: no script in this repository computes it, and the fishing-effort layers it needs are not fetched.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-WEAK: A null result is weakly informative: quarterly effort, a computed swept-area ratio and vessels missing from the layers can each hide a real effect. And there is no baseline before trawling: the layers begin in 2016, so the test is a contrast across places and quarters, never a before-and-after.
hypodrafts/D1.md.C-DZ-D1-ZIP: They are one archive on figshare, `2022_helcom_spatial_effort_intensity.zip`, of 23,051,366 bytes, under `CC BY 4.0`.

hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-CENSOR: *Censored at the bed, and unequally between the arms.* Comparing the two depths each record carries, the share of readings in which the disc reached the bottom is 36.9% at 0–5 m and 10.0% at 5–10 m, against 0.2% at 20–40 m and 0.0% at 40–200 m; the supplier's own flag `SigtTilBund` is set on 26,380 of all 151,203 records.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-EFFN: **Effective n is events, not visits.** One weather system can cover the whole domain, so stations sampled in its wake observe the same storm. Report distinct exceedance events and stations per event — never the number of visits.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-FALSIFY: **Falsified if** the within-station coefficient lies inside the null below; **or** the control deeper than 20 m moves as much as the arm at most 10 m deep; **or** the coarse-substrate coefficient equals the mud one; **or** the lag profile is flat. Together these predictions separate D7 from "winter is murkier."
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-KD: **Second response.** `lys.csv.gz` holds 2,370,091 records of light-attenuation profiles (`LyssvaekkelsesKoefficient`, K_d) at 566 stations with a position; this project's light analysis counts 62,741 casts in them with a positive K_d and a date, and its growing-season casts run from 1980 to 2026.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-KDPATH: Whether the profiles come from an instrument separate from the CTD cast is not established here; this project's list of independent production paths does not count them.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-LICENSE: Licensed: *a coefficient, at station-visit level, for the lagged transparency deficit per unit exceedance, with a depth gradient and a substrate contrast, against those two nulls* — and, if Secchi, K_d and satellite attenuation agree, a stability coefficient across them.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-MARINE: The Open-Meteo marine files under `data/raw/marine/` carry hourly wave height and sea-surface temperature beside the currents `currents.py` reads; those wave heights are a model output too, and nothing here sets them against transparency.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-MECH: Under D7, resuspension is depth-limited — in the wave model held here the orbital velocity at the bed falls with depth through sinh *kh* — substrate-limited, since only mobile fine sediment suspends, and it *relaxes* as that sediment settles again. The predictions, per station-visit, net of station mean, month-of-year and year:
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-MONTHLY: **The monthly product cannot test D7.** The dated raw record can:
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-NOCLOCK: The extract has a date and no clock field.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-NOSHORE: Nor fedtemøg reaching a shore, D7's other outcome, which needs a series of shore condition; none was found in any source this project surveyed.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-NOTOXY: Not licensed: anything about oxygen — transparency is not sulphide, and D7's oxygen outcome needs the chemistry of the resuspended material, which is not held, and for which `fetch_oda.py` lists no topic.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-NULL-DEPTH: **The depth null.** Keep τ and the visits intact; permute *bottom depth* among stations within substrate class and a 50 km neighbourhood. Kills the depth prediction and preserves the rest, including any tendency of shallow stations to lie near the coast.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-NULL-TIME: **The time null.** Circular-shift the whole hourly τ series by whole years ± up to 60 days, re-deriving the lags each draw. Preserves the seasonal cycle and storm autocorrelation exactly; destroys only the registration between *this* storm and *this* visit.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-NULLCONSTR: The constraint: visits sit where and when they sit, and storms are autocorrelated. A shuffle of τ across visits breaks both, and scores any seasonal cycle that storms and transparency share as signal.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-P-DEPTH: **Depth.** Clarity is degraded in the 5 days after an hour of critical-shear exceedance at that station, scaling with the depth attenuation term: large where the bed is at most 10 m deep, zero within noise where it is deeper than 20 m, **in the same storms**.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-P-RELAX: **Relaxation.** The coefficient decays monotonically over the 10 days after an exceedance; a step persisting for weeks is a season, not a storm.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-P-SUB: **Substrate.** Present over GEUS *Mud and sandy mud* / *Muddy sand* / *Quaternary clay and silt*; absent over *Sand* / *Gravel and coarse sand* / *Till/diamicton* / *Sedimentary rock* (the layer is described in [`D1.md`](D1.md)).
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-PANEL: `stations_series.json`, the monthly panel this project analyses, carries 9 variables — temperature, salinity, oxygen and oxygen saturation at surface and bed, and fluorescence — none of them turbidity, each a monthly median per station.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-PREDICTOR: **Predictor.** Bed shear is a model output, not an observation, and this repository has one: `scripts/waves.py` → `data/derived/waves.json`, hourly from 1995-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (271,752 hours): ERA5 wind → the fetch in the wind's direction, read from a table (`data/raw/weather/fetch.json`) that no script in the repository produces → wave growth by Young and Verhagen (1996) → orbital velocity at the bed → Swart friction.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-PROC: Compute fetch per station from the held OSM coastline (`data/raw/osm/coastline.json`) for the shallow stations and the deep controls; run `waves.py`'s chain per station at its own `BundDybde_m`, giving τ(station, hour). Per visit form E_ℓ = max τ in day ℓ before the visit, for ℓ up to 10. Fit an interval-censored (Tobit) Secchi model on E_ℓ — station, month-of-year, year absorbed — interacted with depth and substrate; repeat on K_d and on `Turbiditet`.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-SCOPE: `SigtDybdeMedVandkikkert` — read through a water telescope — is True on 6,104 records, so the Secchi column holds readings taken two ways; a test models the flag or keeps one kind.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-SECCHI: **Response — Secchi depth.** `data/raw/oda/maaledybde.csv.gz` holds 151,203 records; 96,708 carry a positive Secchi depth, a positive bottom depth and a year, 1980 to 2026. By bottom depth: 0–5 m 23,160 · 5–10 m 20,392 · 10–20 m 31,981 · 20–40 m 17,454 · 40–200 m 3,714.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-SRC-DMI: **DMI oceanObs** — the source register records DMI's open API as serving sea level observed at its stations, unauthenticated in testing. Wind setup in a shallow bay is *observed* storm forcing, independent of ERA5 and of any wave model: the anchor τ lacks. **A separate path.**
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-SRC-OC: **Copernicus Marine `OCEANCOLOUR_BAL_BGC_L3_MY_009_133`** — daily satellite observations of plankton, reflectance and transparency as the diffuse attenuation coefficient of light (`KD490`).
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-SRC-OC-PATH: **A separate path**: satellite radiometry, daily, so it can resolve a storm's tail where cloud allows.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-SRC-SS: **ODA water chemistry**, held (`kemi.csv.gz`): suspended solids (`Suspenderede stoffer`) on 19,314 rows and turbidity on 60, from water samples. **A separate path** from the sonde.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-SRC-WAV: **Copernicus Marine `BALTICSEA_MULTIYEAR_WAV_003_015`** — an hourly hindcast of significant wave height, period and direction from the wave model WAM with surface forcing from ECMWF's ERA5, over the Baltic including the Danish Belts, the Kattegat and Skagerrak.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-SRC-WAV-PATH: **Not a separate path**: the same atmosphere as the held wind; only the wave step differs.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-TAIL: **Visits are not drawn at random over the weather.** Hence a test on the relaxation tail, not the storm hour: a design consequence, not a caveat.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-TOBIT: The disc hits bottom exactly when the water is clear, so censoring correlates with the predictor *and* differs between the arms: an uncensored fit would manufacture the depth prediction from censoring alone. Model it interval-censored ("at least the bottom depth").
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-TRANSP: it holds transparency series — Secchi depths, light-attenuation profiles and CTD turbidity. The first two feed this project's light analysis; none has been set against modelled bed shear.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-TURB: **Third response — turbidity is in the archive.** The CTD extract carries `Turbiditet` on 1,076,915 rows and `FDOM` on 890,921 rows, the latter from 2021 to 2026; neither reaches the monthly panel.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-TURBPATH: It is **not a separate production path**: it comes from the same CTD casts as the oxygen channel — another channel of the same path.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-UNCHECKED: It is computed for Køge Bugt only, at fixed depths of 3, 5 and 10 m, and has **never been confronted with an observation** of sediment moving.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-WAVESHARE: The wave model held here puts the modelled bed shear at 3 m above the dead-bed threshold in 61% of all hours, so a monthly median describes a mixture, not an event.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-WIND: Wind is the end of the chain closer to observation, so τ is driven from wind, not from a wave field.
hypodrafts/D7.md.C-KD-D7-XUTM: In all 151,203 records the second easting column `X_UTM321` repeats `X_UTM32`, and there is no northing column, so a position comes from the station register.

hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-C1: **`C1` (the feedback).** At a transect, a drop in vegetation **cover** is followed by a rise in local light attenuation, more strongly than a rise in attenuation is followed by a drop in cover. *Falsified* if the cross-lagged asymmetry is zero or reversed under the nulls below — which is what "the water darkened first, for its own reasons" looks like.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-C2: **`C2` (the block).** Transects that lost cover stay light-limited: light at the bed remains below the eelgrass requirement. *Falsified* by transects where light at the bed has been adequate for 5 consecutive growth seasons and cover has not returned.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-CIRC: The eelgrass **depth limit** is, in DCE's words, an indicator of eutrophication and of the bottom-vegetation quality element, and light attenuation is the factor that matters most for it; the national models express the depth limit through Kd. Regressing it on attenuation re-reads the relation the indicator is built on, not F3.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-CONTIG: A free permutation is the wrong null for anything spatial: on this project's own stations, random connected partitions of matched sizes agree with each other well above chance, by contiguity alone (`docs/data/areas/partition_contiguous.json`).
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-D1: **The response is cover, not depth limit.** Cover per species (`Daekningsgrad (%)`) is its own field in the vegetation topics, apart from the depth limits, and the Danish indicator, as the source register records, uses the main-distribution depth limit. The depth-limit columns are used only as a covariate, to check `C1` is not driven by them.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-D2: **Drop light-limited transects from the depth-limit checks.** The source register records a vegetation field, `Maks dybde begraenset af`, naming why the transect stopped. Where the answer is substrate or end-of-transect, the depth limit is not a light measurement by construction. The field is counted for fill first, and the depth-limit strand runs only on the transects that carry it.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-D3: **Clarity is measured, not inferred.** `LyssvaekkelsesKoefficient` per cast in the light extract, and the daily satellite attenuation `KD490` in the held CMEMS transparency files — neither derived from vegetation.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-FAIL: Failure of both leaves F3 unscored at these transects, not refuted elsewhere.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-FETCH: Add the three vegetation topics to the `TOPICS` of `scripts/fetch_oda.py`, one entry each (`{"emne": "Emne_3_182"}` and its siblings), and run each with an explicit period: `--from 1970-01-01 --to 2026-12-31 --years 5`.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-FITTED: Use the per-transect observed depth limit, never an indicator's fitted one: a fitted depth limit is a model output, and testing a model's output against its own input tests the model.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-GEUS: `data/raw/geus/seabed_sediment_dk.gpkg`, the GEUS seabed-sediment map, is read with `sqlite3` by `scripts/substrate.py`.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-IDS: The register carries only 34 of the 1,415 stations of the monthly series built from the CTD extract, so its identifiers are not the extracts'; a transect is joined to light casts by distance, not by id.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-JOIN: Where a light cast lies within 2 km of a transect, the transect's clarity comes from it; where none does, from CMEMS pixels. The share of transects the radius keeps is reported with the result.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-L4: `C2` is the L4 discrimination. Finding light-adequate, cover-absent transects shows the block is **not** light — it does not say what the block is: seed supply, substrate mobility and wasting disease (T3) all remain. Finding none is consistent with F3's feedback *and* with light simply never having recovered; `C1` is what separates those, which is why both are needed.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-LICENSE: A positive `C1` with lift over `N2` licenses: *at these transects, cover change leads clarity change*. It does **not** license a national statement, does not identify the resuspension mechanism — nothing held here measures sediment flux — and cannot separate eelgrass from drifting macroalgae shading unless the epiphyte and drift columns are filled.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-LYS: `data/raw/oda/lys.csv.gz` holds 2,370,091 records at 566 stations with coordinates.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-MAAL: `data/raw/oda/maaledybde.csv.gz` holds 151,203 records, at 1,176 stations with a bottom depth, and carries `BundDybde_m` and `SigtTilBund`; its Secchi depths are censored at the bed, far more often in shallow water (D7 counts it).
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-MECH: F3 says vegetation loss is self-reinforcing: cover goes, the bed resuspends, the water darkens, and the darkness prevents return. Two consequences follow that can each be wrong.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-N1: **`N1`, temporal.** For `C1`: circularly shift each transect's cover series against its own clarity series by a random whole number of years, at least 2, preserving within-series autocorrelation and the transect's mean. 999 draws; the null distribution of the median cross-lagged asymmetry is computed, not assumed to centre on zero.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-N2: So relabel cover-loss status only *within* strata of substrate class from GEUS × 1 m bottom-depth band, and only across transects connected on a nearest-neighbour graph whose edges crossing the OSM coastline are removed — the same water graph the partition work uses, never the water-body polygons. Report the observed statistic as **lift over this null**, and report the null's own level.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-NEEDS: F3 needs the eelgrass depth limit and cover by station and year, from ODA's vegetation topics; none of them is held here, and `scripts/fetch_oda.py` does not list them.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-NOTUSABLE: **Not usable here:** `docs/data/areas/val_kd.bin` and the coverage cube are indexed by marine water body, a unit in which this project's partition work finds no measured signal. Clarity must come from per-cast light profiles or per-pixel CMEMS.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-NULLS: The nulls are computed, not quoted: a temporal one and a spatial one, because either time or place could fake the result.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-P1: Fetch the three vegetation topics. Count the fill of `Maks dybde begraenset af`, `Daekningsgrad (%)` and both depth-limit columns before using any of them.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-P2: Per transect-year, over the growth season this project's light analysis uses, March to September: median cover; nearest-cast Kd **stratified by cast start depth**, never pooled; bottom depth from the transect's own `Vanddybde maks (m)`; light at bed = exp(−Kd·z).
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-P3: `C1`: per-transect cross-lagged regression at lags of 1 to 3 years, median across transects, against `N1` and `N2`.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-P4: `C2`: count transect-years with at least 5 consecutive adequate growth seasons and cover below 5%; sensitivity over requirements from 8% to 20%.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-P5: Repeat with the CMEMS `KD490` pixels as the clarity source, streamed by year.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-PERIOD: Without a period ODA returns only the currently active network, and `fetch_oda.py` refuses to extract without one.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-REG: `data/raw/oda/stations.csv`, the ODA station register, holds 798,574 records for 6,288 stations, 2,329 of them with a transect end coordinate; its dates run from 1911-05-17 to 2026-09-04.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-SEP: `C1` and `C2` are separable. `C1` can hold and `C2` fail — the feedback is real and something else now holds the system down.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-STARTDEPTH: Its apparent Kd depends on where a cast starts: this project's light analysis gives a median Kd of 0.35 and a median depth reaching 11% of surface light of 6.31 m for casts starting above 2 m, against 0.27 and 8.18 m for casts starting below. Two answers in one column, so Kd is stratified by start depth, never pooled.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-STATUS: The test this page specifies has not been run: no script in this repository computes it.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-STAYS: **What stays circular and cannot be removed:** the light requirement `C2` needs — the share of surface light eelgrass needs at the bed — is physiology, not measured here, and no document pinned in this project gives it. This project's light analysis carries two values for it, 11% and 14% of surface light, as parameters of its own code with no source recorded. If the requirement is wrong, the adequacy call moves with it, so `C2` is reported across requirements from 8% to 20% rather than at one threshold.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-TRANSP: `data/raw/cmems/grid/` holds the CMEMS satellite transparency product as one file per year for the inner waters and for the Arkona basin, `transp__inner__YYYY.nc` and `transp__arkona__YYYY.nc`, each with the daily diffuse attenuation `KD490`; they are streamed one year at a time.
hypodrafts/F3.md.C-AF-F3-VEG: ODA's vegetation topics — eelgrass with bottom fauna, with macroalgae, and the plant itself (`Emne_3_180`, `Emne_3_181`, `Emne_3_182`) — are not held. This project's source register records them, from an authenticated enumeration, as per-transect surveys carrying cover per species, the maximum and main-distribution depth limits, the maximum water depth, the bottom type, epiphyte and drifting-macroalgae cover, and why the transect stopped; each lists fewer stations under the portal's default period than with a period set.

hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-A: **`G1-a`:** *the decline is not mostly solubility* — `dC_sat/dt` is a minority of `dO/dt`. Falsified if the solubility term equals or exceeds the observed decline.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-B: **`G1-b`:** *`dD/dt > 0`* — the deficit widens, as it must if warming drives respiration or stratification faster than ventilation recovers. Falsified by `dD/dt ≤ 0`, or by a `dD/dt` indistinguishable from the year-block null. `G1-b` carries the load-independence claim; `G1-a` decides whom the finding is about.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-BEDDEF: “Near the bed” and “near the surface” are not fixed depths: `stations_series.py` takes, for each cast, the values in the deepest and in the shallowest part of the cast's own sampled depth range, cut at the fraction `0.25` of that range, and puts every such value in a station-month into one median. So `D` can pair temperature, salinity and oxygen from different casts and depths.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-CIRC: It is computed from oxygen, temperature and salinity, so it already contains temperature. **It is never an outcome here.** `D` contains temperature through `C_sat` deliberately — that is the *subtraction* of the solubility channel, the equation coming from outside the archive — and errors in temperature enter `D` but not the year regressor, so they add noise, not trend.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-CLOCK: *Hour.* The CTD extract the panel is built from has no time of day in any row and no column for it. If the sampling hour drifted over the record, the diel oxygen cycle drifted with it, and nothing inside the panel can correct it: this caps the test rather than bounds it. The water-chemistry extract does carry clock values, which can bound the hour only where a cast shares its day with a bottle.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-CSAT: Per station-month, `C_sat` is the oxygen solubility at the panel's near-bed temperature and salinity, from a published solubility equation for seawater, in mg/l; then `O_bed = C_sat(T_bed, S_bed) − D`, so `dO/dt ≡ dC_sat/dt − dD/dt`.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-DATA: `docs/data/areas/stations_series.{json,bin}` holds 679,422 station-months at 1,415 stations, in 564 monthly slots from January 1980, each value a median per station and month. The variables the identity needs are held on: `oxy_bed` 76,980, `temp_bed` 84,656, `sal_bed` 83,309, `temp_surf` 84,668 and `sal_surf` 83,341 station-months.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-DECIMALS: *Precision.* Temperature in the CTD extract is mostly written with more than one decimal: of its 7,501,421 temperature rows, 1,076,874 (14.4%) carry at most one decimal in the original result.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-DEFENCES: If the mix of stations moves, it can tilt a pooled slope; the defences required are (i) within-cell fixed effects, so a station only competes with itself, and (ii) the balanced panel, so entry and exit cannot tilt the slope.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-DEFICIT: `C_sat` is computed from temperature and salinity by an equation from outside the archive, so the first term is **computed, not estimated** from it. The deficit `D` is solubility-neutral by construction and carries the rest: consumption, failed ventilation, advection.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-DEPEND: Whether the dependence the textbook standard error ignores is temporal — a cell's years following one another — or cross-sectional — every cell in a year sampling the same weather — has not been measured here; the year-block null holds under both, and the naive standard error is to be reported beside the block one, with their ratio.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-JOIN: No script here joins them or applies a plausibility filter; a station-month carrying every one of them can be no more common than the rarest, so the joined panel holds at most 76,980 station-months before any filter.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-NULLDESIGN: Not “zero slope”. The estimator is a within-cell fixed-effect slope on year; the constraint imposed is *within station and within calendar month*. The null is a **year-block procedure**: resample the calendar years with replacement, and separately permute year labels attached to whole years, refitting on each draw. That keeps every station effect, the seasonal cycle and the within-year common shock, destroying only the ordering of years against outcome.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-P1: Read `oxy_bed`, `temp_bed`, `sal_bed`, `temp_surf` and `sal_surf` at the offsets the `.json` gives, keyed `station×1000 + month`; apply stated plausibility bounds on value, counting what each removes; compute `C_sat` and `D`; build the trend panel.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-P2: Fixed-effect slopes on year for `O`, `C_sat`, `D`, `T_bed` and `T_surf − T_bed`. The slopes of `O`, `C_sat` and `D` satisfy the identity exactly; report the split as a **share of `dO/dt`**, not a p-value.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-P3: Year-block null (above) for each; report the naive standard error, the block standard error and their ratio.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-P4: Repeat on the balanced panel, on June–September and on December–March. **Agreement across the variants is the finding; disagreement is equally the finding.**
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-P5: Refit `dD/dt` with surface-minus-bed density as a covariate — this *uses* C1's variable and does not test it. What survives is the metabolic-plus-unknown residue, a residue, not a `Q10`.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-PANELRULE: Trend panel = cells (station × calendar month) with at least 8 distinct years **and** a span of at least 15 years. Balanced variant = cells present in both 1990–1999 and 2015–2026. No script here builds either, so neither's size is known.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-QUESTION: So G1's testable content is not *does oxygen fall* but **what share of the long-term fall is the solubility ceiling falling**.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-ROUTES: Warming reaches near-bed oxygen by the routes it names — **solubility**, **stratification** and the **rate of respiration** — and only the first lowers near-bed oxygen whatever is consumed there; the other two act through the consumption beneath the stratified layer, which the load feeds.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-SAT: Archived near-bed oxygen saturation (`oxysat_bed`) is held on 64,493 station-months, fewer than the 76,980 with near-bed oxygen.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-STATUS: The test this page specifies has not been run: no script in this repository computes the solubility term, the deficit or their slopes on the station panel, so no slope, share or null is reported here.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-UNIT: *Unit.* The unit is a station: the panel deliberately carries no water body, and every estimate is within a cell of one station and one calendar month, so none is needed.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-VALUES: *Values.* The panel holds values no water has: station-months of negative oxygen, which the flag record reads as sign inversions. A plausibility filter must be stated, and what each of its bounds removes counted, before any slope.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-WOULD: **Would.** If `dC_sat/dt` matches or exceeds `dO/dt` under the year-block null and across the variants, that licenses: *at the trend panel's stations the long-term near-bed oxygen decline is accounted for by the solubility ceiling alone, and the non-thermodynamic deficit did not widen.* That constrains G1's headline directly: “monotone worsening independent of load” would be true of the water and still not evidence that load reduction failed, the falling term being the one no load policy touches.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-G1-WOULDNOT: **Would not.** It does not measure respiration and cannot: `D` is a standing stock, a respiration rate is a rate, and converting between them needs a ventilation timescale the archive does not hold. A narrowing `D` is equally consistent with load reduction working *and* with the network drifting toward better-ventilated positions — the defences bound that, they do not eliminate it. It says nothing about stratification beyond a difference between the top and the bottom of the sampled range, which is no pycnocline (C1's object), nothing about water bodies, nothing about the stations the span filter drops. And `dD/dt ≈ 0` refutes `G1-b` only at the resolution of monthly medians taken at an unrecorded hour.
hypodrafts/G1.md.C-GI-NOLABEL: No script in this repository defines a split of the stations by the season they are sampled in, so no such label enters this design.

hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-AGG: *Aggregation.* Each value is already a median per station, month and depth layer, over every value in that layer of every cast that month; how many casts went into it is not stored, so I3's effort confound cannot be controlled inside this file: a station visited once and one visited often weigh the same.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-BALRULE: **Balanced panel:** the stations with a June–September `oxy_bed` value in *every* era. Its size, and the share of June–September values outside it, have not been computed here.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-BOOT: **Primary null.** `H0`: the pooled trajectory is what the fixed network would have shown. Cluster bootstrap over the panel's stations — draw as many stations as the panel holds, *with replacement*, carrying each station's entire era-by-era June–September value set, and recompute Δ_fixed(e) = med(e) − med(first era). 5,000 replicates give a percentile band per era; reject `H0` where Δ_pooled(e) falls outside the 95% band.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-CIRC: **On the classification circularity.** A label that sorts stations by the season of their sampling, made on each station's *whole* record, labels a station that switched regime by its aggregate — contaminated by the very time-variation under test. This design avoids the problem rather than fixing it: the balanced panel is defined by **presence**, observable per era, and no behavioural label enters the primary test. Any secondary analysis wanting such a label must assign it **within era**, and report the switch rate before using a pooled label.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-CLOCK: *Hour.* The CTD extract the panel is built from has no time of day in any row and no column for it, so the diel oxygen swing aliases into whichever hour the boat went, per station. The water-chemistry extract does carry clock values, which can bound the hour only where a cast shares its day with a bottle.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-DESIGN: Hold the station set fixed and the season fixed, and recompute the June–September near-bed oxygen trajectory 1985–2024 in eras of 5 years.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-EVENMED: *Resolution.* Where a station-month holds an even number of values, its median is the mean of the two middle values, so a stored value can sit between the steps the raw values were reported in.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-FAIL: **I1 fails** if the two trajectories track each other inside the band in every era — a real possible outcome, and the interesting one: the network's turnover would then not have moved the number, and the composition objection could be set aside for this variable.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-MULT: **Multiplicity.** Pre-register the contrast between the last era and the first as primary; treat the intermediate eras as descriptive, Holm-corrected.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-NOTCAUSE: Anything about oxygen *causes*. Composition is an instrument question.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-NOTTRANSFER: Transfer to other variables, other seasons, or the years before 1985, which the design leaves out.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-NOTTRUE: A claim that the fixed-panel trajectory is the *true* trend. The panel is survivorship-selected: stations present in every era may differ from the ones that came and went, in depth, programme or place. Holding the network fixed trades a composition bias for a selection bias; it does not remove bias. The honest reading of agreement is “turnover did not move this number”, not “this is what the sea did”.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-NOTWB: Any statement about a water body. The panel's stations are wherever they happen to be; they are not a designed sample of anything, and aggregating them into Vandområder would import the model assumption this repository refuses.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-NULLCONSTR: The constraint is *a fixed station set × a fixed season window*, which shrinks n and clusters it into as many groups as the panel has stations. The relevant null is therefore **not** the sampling distribution of a median over independent draws, and no published standard error applies.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-P1: Read `stations_series.bin` at the `oxy_bed` offset the `.json` gives; decode the `uint16` station index, the `uint16` month index and the `float32` value; `year = 1980 + month//12`, calendar month = `month%12 + 1`.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-P3: Balanced panel = the intersection of the per-era station sets.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-P6: Repeat for `oxysat_bed`, `sal_bed` and `temp_bed`. Salinity and oxygen saturation are computed (from conductivity and temperature, and from oxygen, temperature and salinity), so these are not independent replications: a consistent result across them is one result, not several.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-PANEL: `docs/data/areas/stations_series.{json,bin}` holds 679,422 station-months at 1,415 stations, in 564 monthly slots from January 1980, for 9 variables; the `.bin` is 5,435,376 bytes, exactly 8 bytes per station-month, as the layout's `uint16` station index, `uint16` month index and `float32` value per point imply. The variable used, `oxy_bed`, is held on 76,980 station-months at 1,327 stations.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-PRESENCE: So the start and end dates I1 needs are not held; presence must be derived from the observation record itself, era by era.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-REGISTER: **The station register cannot supply station lifespans.** `data/raw/oda/stations.csv` holds 798,574 rows and 6,288 distinct `ObservationsstedNr`, and carries only 34 of the 1,415 series stations. `StartDato` equals `SlutDato` on 796,990 of the 798,574 rows with both dates (99.8%): the field holds a visit date, not a station lifespan — a column named as a validity period carrying an event date.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-SECONDARY: **Secondary null, for the season channel.** Month-stratified station-label permutation: within each (era, calendar-month) cell, permute station labels among observations. Era n, month composition and every visit schedule stay fixed; only the association between *which* station and *what value* is destroyed. It will almost certainly reject — stations differ in depth and level by construction — so it is a check on the season channel, not a test of I1. Do not present rejection here as support.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-STATUS: The test this page specifies has not been run: no script in this repository computes the June–September counts per era, the balanced panel or either trajectory, so no count of them, no band and no p-value is reported here.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-SUPPORT: **I1 is supported** if the era-to-era change measured on the fixed set differs from the change measured on the full pooled record by more than the fixed set's own sampling band — that is, the pooled trajectory lies outside the band in at least one era.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-UNIT: The station is the resampling unit because observations are not independent within it; resampling observations would understate the band, by up to a factor of √(observations per station) when a station's observations move together.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-I1-WOULD: **Would license.** Whether, at the positions watched in every era, the June–September near-bed oxygen change is the change the pooled record reports — and if not, a quantified size for the composition contribution.
hypodrafts/I1.md.C-GI-NOLABEL: No script in this repository defines a split of the stations by the season they are sampled in, so no such label enters this design.

hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-A: **Count and window.** An extremal indicator — an annual minimum, a worst-month value — is an order statistic of the draws. Its expectation moves with the number of draws and with the months they fall in.
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-A-PANEL: The monthly panel records, for each station, which months carry a value, so both the count and the window can be read off it.
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-B: So the daily phase cannot be scored on the panel, whose values carry no hour; it could be bounded only through borrowed clocks, which nothing on this page uses, and nothing in the archive constrains the pre-dawn minimum. Nothing here licenses a claim that the daily-cycle confound is absent or small.
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-B-SUN: **Daily phase.** Daylight at 55°N runs from 7 h at the December solstice to 17 h at the June solstice, so if oxygen follows the sun, sampling held to working hours meets a different phase of its daily cycle as the season moves; the water-chemistry samples whose clock is an observed time rarely visit night or twilight.
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-CLOCK: The CTD extract this panel is built from carries a date and no hour, and so do the Secchi and light-attenuation extracts. The water-chemistry extract carries a clock value per sample, and where a CTD cast shares a station-day with a bottle whose clock is an observed time, `depth_clock.py` lends the cast that time, on the unchecked assumption that the two share a moment.
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-CONSTR: **Constraint:** station-years with every calendar month present. Effort is then fixed, and station composition is fixed inside each unit, so nothing is compared across differently observed units.
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-NEIGHBOUR: I1 asks *which stations* were observed; I3 asks *how often, and when in the year*: the aliasing of a quantity that can vary faster than it is sampled.
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-NULL: **The null is computed, not assumed.** Within the fixed units, draw month-sets from each station-year's own values; the distribution of the indicator over those draws is the null against which any observed path is scored. That severity rises with count is not assumed, since the window effect can run the other way. The null has not been computed here.
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-P1: Build the effort-matched panel: station-years containing all of July, August and September; count them, and the stations carrying them, by decade.
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-P2: Compute the severity indicator twice per station-year: (a) on all available months, (b) on exactly July, August and September. Never aggregate to water bodies; the unit is the station.
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-P3: For each unit, draw 200 month-sets of the same size from that unit's own values to get the null envelope for (a). Score the observed path of (a) against it.
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-P4: Regress each indicator on year with station fixed effects. Compare slopes and the year-to-year path of (a) and (b).
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-P5: Repeat with the August–September window and with a window of at least two of the three months, as sensitivity.
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-PANEL: `docs/data/areas/stations_series.json` holds 679,422 station-months at 1,415 stations over 9 variables: one monthly median per station and variable, in 564 month slots from January 1980. Near-bed oxygen, `oxy_bed`, has 76,980 station-months at 1,327 stations.
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-RANGE: **Values are not range-checked.** `stations_series.py` takes the median of every value in the deepest quarter of each cast's depth range, with no test of range, so values no instrument could give, which the extracts are known to carry, reach the panel. The flag record marks 11 station-months at 6 stations as a sign inversion (I7) and removes nothing.
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-REPLIC: **The panel is a monthly median**, so within-month replication is gone from it. The CTD extract keeps each cast with its date, so whatever replication there is survives there: `hypodraft_ctd.py` counts 152,671 station-days with temperature and salinity there, at 1,478 stations. How many station-months hold more than one sampling day has not been counted here. So the panel can test count and window, and only the extract can test variance within a month.
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-SAT: `oxysat_bed` is computed from oxygen, temperature and salinity, so it is not an independent measurement; it is not used here.
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-STATUS: The test this page specifies has not been run: no script in this repository computes it.
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-TEST: If the count-and-window half is right, an extremal severity indicator computed under **fixed effort and a fixed calendar window** will follow a different path through the years than the same indicator computed on whatever visits each station-year happens to contain. If the two paths coincide inside the resampling envelope, it is refuted as an explanation of the O1 trend.
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-TWO: Two directions must be separated, because they can push opposite ways:
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-WINDOW: **Window.** Which months the draws fall in matters as well: a programme that samples only in the months when oxygen is lowest meets low values with few draws, and one spread over the year dilutes the same number of draws with months when oxygen is high. How the panel's sparsely sampled station-years spread over the calendar has not been counted here.
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-WOULD: **Would.** If (b) is flat where (a) trends, or the slopes differ beyond the envelope, then the O1 severity trend is partly a trend in sampling design, and every extremal indicator in this project must be recomputed effort-matched. If (a) and (b) agree, the count-and-window half is falsified for extremal indicators at monthly resolution — a real result, and the stronger one.
hypodrafts/I3.md.C-IL-I3-WOULDNOT: **Would not.** It says nothing about (i) the daily phase, which stays unscored; (ii) variance within a month, which needs the extract, not this panel; (iii) *rate* indicators, which it does not examine: it is about extremal statistics only, where the count dependence is structural; (iv) which stations were observed, which is I1's.

hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-BGC: Silicate is not among them, so the reanalysis cannot stand in for the silicon side.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-BGC-LIST: Copernicus Marine's Baltic Sea biogeochemistry reanalysis (`BALTICSEA_MULTIYEAR_BGC_003_012`) describes its variables as including nitrate, phosphate, ammonium, dissolved oxygen, pH, chlorophyll-a, Secchi depth, surface partial CO₂ pressure and net primary production, and the catalogue record of its daily dataset lists exactly those: `chl`, `nh4`, `no3`, `nppv`, `o2`, `o2b`, `ph`, `po4`, `spco2` and `zsd`.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-D1: **Temporal ordering** — the winter pool before the bloom, cross-lagged both ways: if the reverse path (last spring's share → this winter's Si) is as strong, the design has failed and says so.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-DENOM: The denominator must be built, not assumed: a community count can hold heterotrophs such as bacteria and ciliates, and records identified only above class cannot be placed in a group. Denominator = records resolving inside the autotrophic protist groups; the unassignable fraction is reported, not distributed.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-DERIVED: Each functional-type variable carries, in the file itself, the provider's note that it is *derived from chl as in Brando et al. (2021)*, and the product's description says the functional types are evaluated by a region-specific algorithm. A field computed from total chlorophyll cannot move where chlorophyll does not, so K1's distinguishing prediction — *composition moves while total biomass need not* — cannot be expressed in these files, let alone tested. They are a chlorophyll field, not an observation of who the biomass is.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-DOME: The ICES Phytoplankton Community dataset is published through the EurOBIS repository as sampling events with occurrence and extended measurement-or-fact records, under a Creative Commons Attribution licence.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-DRAWDOWN: Diatoms take up dissolved silicon to build their cell walls, so a contemporaneous correlation fits either arrow, and the trivial one: a bloom draws Si down, so *low Si with many diatoms* is drawdown, not limitation.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-FALSIFY: **Falsified if:** the slope is indistinguishable from the null below, or it vanishes once chlorophyll is conditioned on — which would say composition only tracks biomass.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-FILES: `data/raw/cmems/grid/` holds 29 yearly files, 1997 to 2025, the first of them partial, of the Copernicus Marine product `OCEANCOLOUR_BAL_BGC_L3_MY_009_133`, the newest of them with 7 variables: total chlorophyll (`CHL`), the functional types `DIATO`, `DINO`, `MICRO`, `NANO` and `PICO`, and a cyanobacteria bloom mask (`CYANOBLOOM`). They are daily satellite retrievals of ocean colour, not cell counts.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-FIXED: Hence position fixed effects and a balanced panel; a station-level permutation is *not* conservative enough, because neighbouring stations can share water.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-LICENSE: A coefficient — diatom carbon share against pre-bloom Si:DIN, at sampling-position level, against a persistence-aware null, for a stated denominator and currency. **Not** a statement about total production, oxygen, any water body, or whether cutting nitrogen helps: K1's appeal is that cutting N raises Si:N, and this measures an association, not that intervention.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-NEEDS: K1 needs dissolved silicate alongside N and P at the same stations and dates, and species-level phytoplankton counts. The silicate half is held; the counts are not.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-NOCOUNTS: Species-level phytoplankton counts are not held here, so the assemblage half cannot be scored; whether that dataset's measurement records carry cell counts for Danish samples has not been checked against anything held.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-NULLRULE: Not the statistic's nominal null. A yearly series of pre-bloom Si:DIN can persist from one year to the next, and a persistent series crosses a threshold set for independent years more often than that threshold allows. The threshold must come from surrogates that keep the series' own persistence — circular shifts of the years, and phase-randomised series with its spectrum — computed on the series actually used; neither has been computed here.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-P1: Fetch the counts with their measurement records, paged to disk by year, never held in memory at once.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-P2: Group by sample event; **keep only events where every occurrence carries an abundance**, and report how many events that drops.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-P3: Normalise to cells per litre by each record's own unit, never by a unit assumed for the column or the file.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-P4: Convert to carbon with a published biovolume list, report the share of abundance records that match it, and resolve synonyms and higher-rank identifications before relying on that share.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-P5: **The currency is not neutral.** Report the diatom share both by carbon and by cell number, and state the rule for what counts as one individual.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-P6: Chemistry: take it from the held water-chemistry extract, which joins to a station by identity rather than by distance and date.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-PANEL: **A second null to absorb:** the panel is not fixed. The surface cells (one station, date and depth) behind `rescore.py`'s pooled yearly Si:DIN median number 191 in 1980 and 3,449 in 2002, among the years it keeps, so an across-year statistic on pooled medians is partly a statistic about how much was sampled.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-POOLED: The only Si:DIN computed from it is `rescore.py`'s yearly median of surface Si:DIN pooled over every month: not the January–February pre-bloom quantity specified below, and not a test of the premise (see [C-SIDIN](../CLAIMS.md#C-SIDIN)).
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-SHIFTER: **An exogenous shifter** — silicon delivered by rivers is set upstream, not by marine diatoms. The source register records ODA's river-transport topic (*Vandløb / Stoftransport*) as carrying `Silicium` monthly per station with discharge; it is not fetched here. Discharge also delivers N, P and stratification, so this is a partial instrument and must be reported as one.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-SHOCK: **An asymmetric policy shock** — where nitrogen was cut by policy and silicon was not, a step in Si:DIN driven by the N term alone is exogenous to diatoms in a way the Si term is not.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-SILICATE: The water-chemistry extract held here, `data/raw/oda/kemi.csv.gz`, carries silicon (`Silicium`) on 147,711 samples that `scripts/rescore.py` accepts, at 491 stations over 1974-2026, beside NO₂⁻+NO₃⁻ on 160,198 and NH₄⁺ on 150,024: one value per sample, joinable by station and date.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-STATUS: The test this page specifies has not been run: no script in this repository computes it.
hypodrafts/K1.md.C-KD-K1-TEST: At a **sampling position** (never a water body), the pre-bloom silicon pool sets the diatom fraction the following bloom can reach. Regress the **March–April diatom share of phytoplankton carbon** on the **preceding January–February median surface Si:DIN** at the same position, with position fixed effects. K1 predicts a positive slope **that survives conditioning on total chlorophyll**: the share must move where biomass does not.

hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-COMP: **Composition.** If the stations reporting change over the record (I1), station effects absorb their levels but not their seasonal timing. A split into summer-peaked and year-round stations must then state its rule, including a minimum number of observations: a station seen in a single calendar month has a seasonal resultant of exactly one by construction, and would count as perfectly seasonal.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-CONSTR: Constraint: annual index years **1989–2025** (37 years), windows of **at least 10 years**, giving **406 admissible windows**.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-CORE: The test is to be repeated on a fixed core of stations reporting throughout the index period, which a change of composition cannot move.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-FALSIFY: **Falsified if:** over the full space of admissible windows, the spread of fitted slopes, and the fraction of them that are positive, both fall inside the interval generated by simulating one constant slope with matched `AR(1)` noise. Then the window-dependence is noise around a single rate, the number is estimable, and L3's strong reading is not established for this variable.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-H0: **`H0`, no trend at all.** Each window's slope is then noise, as likely positive as negative, so finding both signs across the windows is expected with no trend at all: *a sign flip on its own does not tell a trend from none.*
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-H1: **`H1`, one constant slope equal to the fitted full-window slope, plus matched noise.** This is the null that L3's strong reading must beat.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-INDEX: Index = two-way fixed effects (station + calendar month, alternating demeaning to convergence), then the annual mean of residuals.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-LEVELS: Station effects absorb level differences, so composition change in *levels* cannot drive the index.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-LICENSE: Licensed, once run: whether near-bed oxygen in this panel shows window-dependence beyond one constant rate with matched autocorrelation, for this variable and these stations. Nothing is licensed yet.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-NOTLIC: Not licensed: anything about chlorophyll, nutrient loading, or the modelled reference condition, which is where L3's stake actually lies (L1, L2). Nothing causal.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-NULLPROC: **The null is not "zero sensitivity".** For each station set, estimate ρ and σ from the detrended index, then simulate 4,000 `AR(1)` series of the same length and compute the same 406-window surface. Two nulls:
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-OXY: Variable used: **`oxy_bed`**, near-bed oxygen in mg/l: 76,980 station-months at 1,327 stations.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-PANEL: `docs/data/areas/stations_series.json` holds 679,422 station-months, the sum of its 9 variables' counts, at 1,415 stations, in 564 month slots from January 1980; `stations_series.bin` is 5,435,376 bytes, 8 per station-month, as the declared layout of a `uint16` station index, a `uint16` month index and a `float32` value requires.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-PRE: Nor anything before the panel's first year, 1980, which `cube.py` fixes: the CTD extract it is built from holds station-days with temperature and salinity from 1970, and those earlier years are not in the panel. L3 is about where monitoring records begin, so the earlier years matter to it.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-RANGE: `stations_series.py` takes the median of every value in the deepest quarter of each cast's depth range, with no test of range, so values no instrument could give, which the extracts are known to carry, reach the panel; the flag record marks 11 station-months at 6 stations as a sign inversion (I7) and removes nothing. A test must set its own bounds and say how many values they drop.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-READINGS: L3 has a weak reading and a strong reading, and only the strong one is a claim about the sea.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-RESID: Both inflate the year-to-year residual; the null below is matched to the residual actually observed, so they widen the null rather than being smuggled into the signal.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-SAT: **Thermometer.** The same surface can be computed on `oxysat_bed` (64,493 station-months at 1,152 stations): oxygen as a share of what the water holds at saturation, at its temperature and salinity. A decline in concentration that is absent in saturation points to solubility rather than oxygen supply. Not computed here.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-SATCHK: The saturation cross-check uses `oxysat_bed`, which is computed from oxygen, temperature and salinity, and is reported as a robustness check only.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-SLOPE: Whatever the result, a single slope is not licensed on its own: any published rate needs its window and its `H1` interval printed beside it.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-STATUS: The test this page specifies has not been run: no script in this repository computes it.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-STRONG: **Strong:** *the window-dependence exceeds what a single constant rate plus the series' own autocorrelated noise would produce* — i.e. the record contains genuinely different eras, so "the trend" is not a well-defined quantity and reporting one number is a category error.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-STRUCT: Two further faults are structural and are not fixed, only declared. The panel is a monthly median per station, so within-month spread and any daily oxygen cycle are gone from it, and the CTD extract it is built from carries a date and no hour.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-SUPPORT: **Supported if:** the observed surface is more dispersed, or its sign-share further from a single-trend expectation, than that simulation allows.
hypodrafts/L3.md.C-IL-L3-WEAK: **Weak:** *a slope fitted to a Danish series changes when you move the cut.* That is true of any noisy series, whatever the sea did, and is not worth testing.

hypodrafts/TRIAGE.md.C-TR-ALL: This page puts **all 166 lettered hypotheses in [HYPOTHESES.md](../HYPOTHESES.md)** each in exactly one class, with the specific blocker.
hypodrafts/TRIAGE.md.C-TR-BEYOND: Add the 20 that need an experiment and **37% of the hypothesis field is beyond reach of any reanalysis of the data this project holds or has found.**
hypodrafts/TRIAGE.md.C-TR-BUNDFAUNA: Of the fetches not yet made, ODA's bottom-fauna topic (`bundfauna`) is named in the blocker for 8: D9, D11, F1, F2, H3, K14, W4 and T2.
hypodrafts/TRIAGE.md.C-TR-CAVEAT: The classification is mine and is itself an untested partition, exactly as the 17 groups are (PLAN.md says so of them). Two judgements are load-bearing and contestable: I treated *not fetched but fetchable* as **blocked on a fetch** rather than unscoreable even where nobody has confirmed the topic contains what its name suggests; and I treated *measured somewhere in the world but not in Denmark* as unscoreable **for this archive**, which is a statement about Denmark's monitoring rather than about nature. The 4 entries I could not place at all are marked *not established* rather than guessed.
hypodrafts/TRIAGE.md.C-TR-CLASSES: **Class definitions.** *Testable now* — consequence, a source in hand, and a null computable under the constraint imposed. *Blocked on a fetch* — named, with whether it needs credentials. *Blocked on resolution* — needs depth, sub-monthly time, per-measurement position, or the measurement-level store. *Unscoreable* — the deciding dimension has no column and never did; **this is not a refutation**. *Needs an experiment* — no observational design reaches it. *Not established* — I could not tell, and say so rather than guess.
